entries.title: Mysteries
entries.summary: Introduces mysteries as paths to greater power needing sacrifices; characters in the four Mystery Cult Houses are Initiated into the Outer Mystery as apprentices and seek deeper mysteries in play.
quotes: Player characters in the Mystery Cult Houses are Initiated into the Outer Mystery as apprentices, but must seek Initiation into deeper mysteries in play.

entries.title: Mystery Cults: Rumors and Using the Examples
entries.summary: Explains how the example cults are to be used and how a character hears rumor of a cult, and that initiation schedules are examples only: the Mystagogue may substitute alternative Virtues and has several Initiation Scripts for each.
quotes: Communication + Order of Hermes Lore vs. an Ease Factor of 15

entries.title: Summoning Spirits
entries.summary: Hermetic magic can bring a spirit instantly to the caster without granting control. A Formulaic or Spontaneous spell suffices for a spirit in Mythic Europe, but a spirit in another realm needs a Ritual.
quotes: Summoning spells are normally cast at Arcane Connection range, making them quite high level.

entries.title: Spirits and Hermetic Magic
entries.summary: How Hermetic magi summon and control Airy Spirits with Rego, and the extra requirements for summoning a Daimon's Aspect, with theurgist advantages.
quotes: the spell of the non-theurgist must have a base level equal to twice the Daimon's Might

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition, Chapters 4, 8 and 9

entries.title: Losing the Gift
entries.summary: For player characters, losing or suppressing The Gift is the player's choice and never a die roll; for storyguide characters it can be chosen or determined by an optional botch-dice roll after a stressful laboratory season.
quotes: For a player character, losing The Gift is always the player's choice and never decided by a die roll.
roll an additional number of botch dice equal to the parens' Lab Total divided by 10 (round up)

entries.title: New Spell Guidelines: Rego Terram (Hermetic Geometry) (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar with new Rego Terram guidelines for reshaping earth into perfect or imperfect geometric shapes.

entries.title: New Spell Guidelines: Intellego (Form) counting (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar giving new Intellego (Form) guidelines for counting individuals in a Target, with or without sorting them into categories.

entries.title: Born with The Gift
entries.summary: Discusses whether The Gift is hereditary in a saga, with an adjusted Ease Factor for finding Gifted children if it is, and how Gifted babies relate to the Order.
quotes: reduce the Ease Factor to 6

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.53 Blood Rights

entries.title: (Mystery Cult) Lore
entries.requires: Membership or study of a Mystery Cult
entries.summary: Cult-specific lore Ability covering rites, symbolism and signs of membership, needed for Initiation rites and some cult books; explains how experience is gained and what happens when it is learned without instruction.
quotes: In game terms, Experience points in Cult Lore are acquired like any other knowledge
A magus may build the knowledge from 0, even without instruction

entries.title: Mystery Initiation
entries.requires: Initiation into a Mystery cult (House Lore)
entries.summary: Summary of how a Mystagogue's Initiation Total is compared with a Target Level (no die roll), including Target Levels, the effect of earlier Ordeals, and the minimum.
quotes: INITIATION TOTAL: Presence + (House) Lore + Script bonus
To Initiate a Minor Virtue known by the Mystagogue, the target level is 15
To Initiate a Major Virtue known by the Mystagogue, the target level is 21

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition, Chapter 2: Entering the Mysteries

entries.title: The Initiation Script
entries.requires: Initiation into a Mystery cult (House Lore)
entries.summary: A written text describing a successful Initiation, whose price may be an Ordeal, a Quest or a Sacrifice, and whose bonuses contribute to the Initiation Total if followed exactly.

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition, Chapter 2: Entering the Mysteries

entries.title: Example Elements of an Initiation Script
entries.requires: Initiation into a Mystery cult (House Lore)
entries.summary: Table of common Script bonuses for special place and time, Quests, sacrifices and Ordeals of varying severity.
quotes: Initiate has to complete a specific Quest

entries.title: Varying a Script
entries.requires: Initiation into a Mystery cult (House Lore)
entries.summary: A Mystagogue may modify an Initiation Script with a test against an Ease Factor depending on whether a component is added or changed; only one change per Initiation is allowed.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + (House) Lore vs. Ease Factor

entries.title: Mystery Initiation: Initiation Total and Target Levels
entries.requires: Initiation into a House Mystery (Bjornaer, Criamon, Merinita or Verditius)
entries.summary: Summarises how a Mystagogue's Initiation Total is compared against a Target Level to initiate a Major or Minor mystery Virtue, with no die roll. Gives the Target Levels, the penalty for lacking the Virtue, and reductions after earlier Ordeals.
quotes: Initiation Total = Presence + (House) Lore + Script bonus
To initiate a Minor Virtue known by the Mystagogue: Target Level 15
To initiate a Major Virtue known by the Mystagogue: Target Level 21

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition, Chapter 2: Entering the Mysteries

entries.title: The Initiation Script
entries.summary: Explains that an Initiation Script is a written text, like a Lab Text, describing a successful Initiation and the Ordeal, Quest and Sacrifice components that supply bonuses to the Initiation Total.

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition, Chapter 2: Entering the Mysteries

entries.title: Varying a Script
entries.summary: A Mystagogue whose Script falls short can test to extend it with a new component or change an existing one, but only one change per Initiation; a failed test means that Initiation would fail but can be retried in another season.
quotes: The Ease Factor is 9 to extend the Script with a new component
The Ease Factor is 12 to change a component

entries.title: Character Creation and the Mysteries
entries.requires: Starting a magus already Initiated into a Mystery cult (storyguide permission)
entries.summary: Rules for starting a magus who already holds House Mystery Virtues: they use ordinary Virtue and Flaw slots, and for older characters an Initiation costs the experience of one lab season. Includes the sidebar of common Script element bonuses.
quotes: subtracts 10 experience points from the character's total

entries.title: Example Elements of an Initiation Script
entries.summary: Sidebar listing the Initiation Total bonuses commonly granted by Script elements such as special places or times, Quests, sacrifices and Ordeals of varying severity.
quotes: +3 Initiate has to complete a specific Quest
+9 Initiate suffers an Ordeal inflicting a Major Flaw or removing a Major Virtue

entries.title: Guides and Mystagogues in Criamon Initiation
entries.summary: Describes how a guide fills the Mystagogue role in Criamon Initiations using the same numbers and formulae, and notes the Paths of the Mirror and Strife as exceptions with formal Initiation by superiors.

entries.title: Psychodrama
entries.summary: Advice for running introspective avenue ordeals as allegorical stories inside the magus's mind; failure may block progress or force Twilight checks.
quotes: failure can force checks for Twilight

entries.title: Path of the Body Initiation Scripts
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
entries.summary: Initiation Script target levels, ordeals and script bonuses for each avenue of the Path of the Body.
quotes: Target level 21, as Major Virtue (Minor Potency in an aspect of Corpus, may use Enigmatic Wisdom in lieu of Medicine and Chirurgy)

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Initiation Scripts

entries.title: Path of Seeming Initiation Scripts
entries.summary: Initiation Script target levels, ordeals and script bonuses for each avenue of the Path of Seeming.
quotes: Target level 21: Package treated as a Major Virtue (Clear Thinker, Common Sense, and Keen Vision)

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Initiation Scripts

entries.title: Path of Strife Initiation Scripts
entries.summary: Initiation Script target levels, ordeals and script bonuses for each avenue of the Path of Strife, including the alternative first-station script for killing the Primus.
quotes: Target level 21: Treated as a Major Virtue (may sense magic and use a weapon with Enigmatic Wisdom score)

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Initiation Scripts

entries.title: Path of Walking Backwards Initiation Scripts
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of Walking Backwards
entries.summary: Initiation Script target levels, ordeals and script bonuses for each avenue of the Path of Walking Backwards.
quotes: Target level 21, Major Virtue (Gentle Gift) or elimination of Flaw (Blatant Gift)

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Initiation Scripts

entries.title: Initiation into the Mysteries of Verditius
entries.summary: How the general Mystery initiation rules are applied in House Verditius, including the Mystagogue's Initiation Total and the fact that the Outer Mystery needs no Verditius Cult Lore score.
quotes: Initiation Total = Presence + Verditius Cult Lore + Script bonus
A Verditius Initiate does not need a score in Verditius Cult Lore to be initiated into the Outer Mystery of the House.

entries.title: Verditius Initiation Scripts
entries.summary: The list of Script components specific to Verditius initiations (travel to a Forge, Quests, Ordeals, Sacrifices) and the bonus each one adds to the Initiation Total.
quotes: +6 The Initiate must perform a unique Quest
+3 The Initiate Sacrifices a lesser enchanted item whose combined powers are of at least the fourth magnitude.

entries.title: Verditius Cult Lore
entries.summary: Describes the Arcane Ability that holds the House's secrets, is raised like any Ability, and can be Trained as well as Taught by any member with a sufficient score.
quotes: Training allows every Verditius magus who has at least a Verditius Cult Lore score of 2 to instruct the lower Initiates in the House's secrets

entries.title: Outer Mystery of Verditius Magic
entries.summary: The initiation that every Verditius apprentice undergoes at the Forges of Hephaestus, granting the Verditius Magic Virtue, with its Target Level, Mystagogue requirement and Script bonus.
quotes: Mechanically, the Initiation Target Level is 15.
The Initiation Script has a bonus of +12

entries.title: Initiating Hermetic Magi into Verditius
entries.summary: The special ritual by which an already-Gauntleted magus of another House joins House Verditius: a probationary period, the Embrace of Boethius that forces reliance on casting tools, Warping, possible Twilight, and the traits and Virtue gained.
quotes: He also develops the Personality Trait Proud 1
He receives the Minor Hermetic Virtue Verditius Magic and gains a Reputation, Convert 1, in the House

entries.title: Learning the Inner Mysteries of Verditius
entries.summary: The Verditius Cult Lore scores a Mystagogue or Initiate needs at each stage (apprentice initiation, Minor Inner Mysteries, Major Inner Mysteries), and how self-initiation differs from learning from another member.
quotes: A magus must increase his score to 2 before Initiating an apprentice whose Arts he wants to open at the same time.
He should have a Verditius Cult Lore score of 5 before he is Initiated into any of the Major Inner Mysteries.

entries.title: Verditius Ordeals
entries.summary: Sample Ordeals used to initiate Verditius Inner Mysteries (Sever the Ties That Bind, Self-Mutilation, Prone to Chance, Averse to Risk, Increased Hubris), each imposing a Flaw or personality change.
quotes: Each Ordeal may only be used once by a single magus.
The first Ordeal, undertaken to learn the first Minor Inner Mystery, always grants the Minor Flaw Hubris.

entries.title: Mystery Virtues Taught to Non-Initiates
entries.summary: Explains that Mystery Virtues, unlike intrinsic magical gifts, can be taught to the uninitiated under special circumstances, and what the cults do to those who leak their secrets.
quotes: This usually requires a Minor Breakthrough

entries.title: Lexicon of the Mysteries
entries.summary: Glossary of the terms used for Mystery Cult play, including Cabal Legacy, Common Magics, Initiation Script, Mystagogue, Probationer and School.
quotes: Initiation Script: A document that sets out the rites, teachings, and prerequisites for Initiation, used by a Mystagogue to conduct an Initiation.

entries.title: Entering a Mystery Cult
entries.summary: Describes the three ways a magus is drawn into a cult, the probationer stage, the season spent learning (Mystery Cult) Lore, and what Initiation grants (a Mystery Virtue plus possible Ordeal Flaws that cannot be undone).
quotes: attaining a score of 1 or more in the Ability (Mystery Cult) Lore
Thus magic cannot undo Initiation effects.

entries.title: Revised Ability: (Mystery Cult) Lore
entries.summary: Defines (Mystery Cult) Lore as the Organization Lore of a particular cult, covering its rites, signals and ceremonies, and says how experience in it is gained and how it can fragment a cult.
quotes: (Mystery Cult) Lore is the (Organization) Lore of a particular cult.

entries.title: (Mystery Cult) Lore and Degrees of Initiation
entries.summary: Gives the usual (Mystery Cult) Lore scores required for a first Initiation, later Initiations and the inner circle of a cult.
quotes: A score of 6 is normally required for Initiation to the inner circle

entries.title: Quests, Ordeals, and Sacrifices
entries.summary: Explains the three prices of Initiation: Ordeals that inflict a permanent Flaw but ease later Initiations, Quests that are always stories taking at least a season, and Sacrifices of time, wealth or items.
quotes: All Initiation Quests take at least one season.

entries.title: Distractions and the Initiate
entries.summary: Special rule for what happens when an Initiation season is interrupted by distractions, which can make the Initiation fail.
quotes: for each month lost to distractions, reduce the Initiation Total by one-third of its original amount (rounding fractions up)

entries.title: Time and Initiation
entries.summary: States that an Initiation, including any Ordeal, takes an entire season in which no other activity is possible, and that the probationer needs a level of (Mystery Cult) Lore first.
quotes: the Initiation (including associated Ordeals) itself requires an entire season

entries.title: Time and the Mystagogue
entries.summary: Says how much of the Mystagogue's own time an Initiation costs, normally a short distraction unless he is teaching a Supernatural Ability.
quotes: generally amounts to a seven-day distraction for the Mystagogue

entries.title: The Mechanics of Initiation
entries.summary: Introduces the principle that Mystery progress gives more gain than loss with no fixed ratio, measured in stories and seasons, and that Hermetic Flaws can be taken as Sacrifices of power.
quotes: progress in a Mystery Cult depicts an increase in power, with more gain than loss, and no fixed ratio

entries.title: The Mystagogue
entries.summary: Describes the Mystagogue as a role (not a title) held by whoever conducts an Initiation, who must have the best (Mystery Cult) Lore and a higher degree than the Initiate; Presence makes leading Initiations easier.
quotes: A high Presence makes leading Initiations easier

entries.title: Virtues Initiated
entries.summary: Says which Virtues can be gained by Initiation and how Initiation lets Supernatural Abilities be learned without the usual study penalty, reaching level 1 after a season with a teacher.
quotes: Mystery Cults can avoid the penalties described there through Initiation rituals and Ordeals

entries.title: Initiation Rites
entries.summary: The core Initiation procedure: the Mystagogue's Initiation Total has no die roll and must exceed a Target Level that depends on whether the Virtue is Major or Minor, whether the Mystagogue knows it, and any previous Ordeal.
quotes: Initiation Total: Presence + (Mystery Cult) Lore + Script Bonus
To Initiate a Minor Virtue known by the Mystagogue, the Target Level is 15
There is a minimum Target Level of 9 no matter how great a reduction is applied.

entries.title: The Initiation Script
entries.summary: Lists the components of an Initiation Script and the bonus each adds to the Initiation Total (travel, Quests, Ordeals, Sacrifices, Mystagogue's time, sympathetic bonus), with three sample Scripts and the rules for when a bonus is invalid.
quotes: +9: The Initiate suffers a Major Ordeal inflicting a specific Major Flaw during the Initiation.
+3: The Initiate has to complete a specified Quest.

entries.title: Example Initiation Script Designs
entries.summary: Notes on applying Scripts to non-player characters and how previous Ordeals usually make up the shortfall for Major Virtues.
quotes: Note that the process of Initiation relies upon the Mystagogue's Presence + (Mystery Cult) Lore, not the Initiate's.

entries.title: Example: Darius Undergoes Initiation
entries.summary: A worked example of a probationer's first two Initiations showing the Initiation Total, Target Level changes, Script bonuses and Ordeal reductions in play.
quotes: His Initiation Total before the Script bonus is, therefore, a respectable 10.

entries.title: Modifying the Initiation Script
entries.summary: A Mystagogue can vary an existing Script with a roll against an Ease Factor that depends on whether a component is added, changed or removed, with only one change attempted per Initiation and a failed change leaving the original Script usable.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + (Mystery Cult) Lore vs. Ease Factor
The Ease Factor is 9 to extend the Script by adding a new component
The Ease Factor is 15 to remove a component from the Script, reducing the Script bonus.

entries.title: Experimental Scripts
entries.summary: Procedure for a Mystagogue with no adequate Script to experiment on a new one: choose a Risk level, roll on the Extraordinary Results chart, check the rite's validity, receive a sympathy bonus, then compare the Initiation Total with the Target Level.
quotes: Roll a Stress Die + Risk Modifier on the Extraordinary Results chart on ArM5, page 109.
Roll a Simple Die + Risk Modifier + Intelligence + (Mystery Cult) Lore vs. Ease Factor of (9 + Proposed Bonus)
Presence + (Mystery Cult) Lore + Revised Script Bonus + Risk Modifier

entries.title: Inventing Your Own Cult
entries.summary: How player characters can found a new Mystery Cult: the storyguide creates a new (Mystery Cult) Lore, characters study it, and one of them eventually experiments to produce the first Initiation Script.
quotes: the storyguide to create a new (Mystery Cult) Lore for the new cult

entries.title: Experimenting To Discover a New Minor Virtue Script
entries.summary: Worked example of a Mystagogue experimenting to create a new Script (risk modifier, validity roll, sympathy bonus, Initiation Total) and a later Mystagogue extending it.
quotes: Her player rolls Intelligence +3 and Seventh Wave Lore 6 vs. an Ease Factor of 9 (to add a component).

entries.title: Responsibilities of Membership
entries.summary: Guidelines on duties, annual vis dues and time commitments that a cult can demand of its Initiates and how to balance them against character progression.
quotes: A single pawn of vis a year is a reasonable symbolic requirement
A donation of perhaps seven or more pawns of vis seems appropriate for Initiation into a new degree.

entries.title: Progression in a Mystery Cult
entries.summary: Rule of thumb for how quickly characters should gain Initiations in slow, medium and fast sagas, measured in stories more than years.
quotes: the figure of three years per Initiation provides a reasonable rule of thumb

entries.title: Initiation into Major Potent Magic
entries.summary: Major Potent Magic is normally Initiated as a progression that replaces Minor Potent Magic, making the loss an Ordeal.
quotes: Major Potent Magic may be (and normally is) Initiated as a progression from a Minor Potent Magic

entries.title: Structure of the Volshebnii Mechtateli
entries.summary: How the dream-magic cult is organised: only two degrees, initiation offered in dream to those with strong Imaginem and Mentem aptitude, and the Virtues a mentor may teach beyond Dream Magic.
quotes: It acknowledges only two degrees

entries.title: The Death of A Thousand Nightmares (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar on the cult's penalty for intruders at the Vermilion Temple: an embodied personal nightmare that non-Initiates cannot escape, though Initiates can intervene with Imaginem magic.

entries.title: The Neo-Mercurians
entries.summary: The Neo-Mercurian Mystery Cult: its simple three-fold local ranks (Messengers, Congregation, Priests) and the list of Virtues it teaches by Initiation, which a storyguide may pick from.
quotes: The Neo-Mercurians have no system of degrees or ranks at local level, beyond a very simple three-fold division:

entries.title: Structure of the Legion
entries.summary: How the Legion of Mithras is organised: underground temples in strong Magic auras, disciplined Auxiliary grogs and companions who support members, and ranks equivalent to degrees in other cults.
quotes: The Auxiliary Legion is open to faithful grogs and companions

entries.title: First Rank: Ravens
entries.summary: Initiation as a Raven requires an Ordeal oath giving a minor personality Flaw, followed by a season of training in the Virtue Strong-Willed.
quotes: the swearing of a magical oath that sears into the Initiates' being a new minor personality flaw: Dutybound (Legion of Mithras)

entries.title: Second Rank: Brides
entries.summary: Initiation as a Bride calls for a Quest to investigate a minor matter, then a season of tuition under the Lions in the Virtue Clear Thinker.
quotes: taught by a season of careful tuition under the Lions (high-ranking Initiates who reside at the temple) the Virtue Clear Thinker

entries.title: Third Rank: Soldiers
entries.summary: Initiation as a Soldier requires the candidate to lead a heroic Quest against a terrible enemy of the Order, followed by a third season of training in a warrior's Virtue.
quotes: the Virtue Reserves of Strength or Enduring Constitution

entries.title: Fourth Rank: Lions (Captain)
entries.summary: Initiation as a Lion needs repeated Quests including commanding Soldiers and Auxiliaries, teaches Inscription on the Soul, and requires seven years living at the temple, which grants an exceptional bonus to the next Initiation Total.
quotes: gaining a +5 bonus to their next Initiation Total, despite the normal limit on the bonus of +1 for time spent serving a Mystery Cult

entries.title: A Typical Raven Initiation Script (sidebar)
entries.summary: Worked example of an Initiation Script for the Raven rank: the Mystagogue's qualifications, the target level after a Minor Ordeal reduction, and the Quest and seasonal Sacrifice components with their bonuses.
quotes: the Target Level is 12 and an Initiation Script that grants a bonus of +5 is typically employed

entries.title: Fifth Rank: Persian
entries.summary: The top rank a player character is likely to reach; initiation calls for sacrificing the magus's talisman for a silver sickle replacement, and teaches the mystery of spirit familiars.
quotes: The Persian is always Initiated into the mystery of spirit familiars

entries.title: Typical Initiation Script for Philosophers of Rome (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar giving a worked Initiation Script for Hermetic Synthemata among the Philosophers: Mystagogue requirements, and the Script bonus built from sympathetic, wealth and time-sacrifice components.
quotes: The Script bonus is usually about +6 for this Initiation.

entries.title: The Structure of the Philosophers of Rome
entries.summary: Loosely organised congregations with no fixed degrees: new Initiates are first taught Hermetic Synthemata and usually Spell Binding, further Virtues of Hermetic theurgy go only to ambitious members, and ascension needs a supporting network of cultists with no known script.
quotes: All Initiates who are tutored by an existing cult Mystagogue are first taught the secret of the Virtue Hermetic Synthemata

related.text: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes

entries.title: Structure of the Children of Hermes
entries.summary: The Children of Hermes initiate by a missionary teaching Children of Hermes Lore for a season, then granting a Mystery Virtue and a copy of the Script; members owe yearly vis dues and recruit others in a pyramid. The cult assimilates other cults' Lore into its own Initiation Scripts.
quotes: She then becomes liable for the yearly dues that are paid in two or more pawns of vis

entries.title: Sample Initiation Script for the Children of Hermes (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar giving a worked Script for the Major Supernatural Virtue Augury and Divination (ophiomancy) with a Quest, a season of study and sacrifice, and an Ordeal that bestows a Major Flaw; shows the large Script bonus needed with a weak Mystagogue.
quotes: the Initiation Script is designed to give a +14 bonus
The Initiate must be quite advanced in cult lore and possess a score of 6 to be Initiated into a Major Virtue.

entries.title: Sample Initiation Script: Fraternity of Samos
entries.summary: Worked example of an Initiation Script for the first Samos degree, showing how a special bonus, a season of teaching and a Minor Ordeal Vow add up to the script bonus.
quotes: Initiation Scripts with a bonus of +7 are very common
for a total Initiation Script bonus of +7

entries.title: Sample Initiation Script: Disciples of the Worm
entries.summary: Worked example of the Spell Binding Initiation Script, itemizing season of work, tomb ordeal, teaching, offerings and sympathetic bonus.
quotes: a +9 Script is commonly employed to Initiate second degree disciples into the Mysteries of spell binding
for a total of +9

entries.title: Sample Initiation Script: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.summary: Worked example of the first Initiation of the Knights, with a Minor Ordeal that lowers the target level, a quest to the Castle, and a sacrifice for outfitting as a knight.
quotes: This Initiation Script confers a +7 bonus; it contains a Minor Ordeal that lowers the target level for this Initiation to 12
which creates the flaw Dutybound (+3)

entries.title: Hedge tradition Initiations
entries.requires: Hedge tradition that teaches powers by Initiation
entries.summary: A Mystagogue directs the Initiate through a Script of mystically significant tasks; an Initiation Total plus Script Bonus is compared to an Ease Factor and, on success, the Initiate gains a power, usually a Virtue.
quotes: If the Mystagogue does not personally know the power then the Ease Factor is increased by 3 (if the power is a Minor Virtue), or by 9 (if the power is a Major Virtue).
The Script Bonus is added to the Initiation Total.

entries.title: UnGifted Initiations
entries.requires: Hedge tradition that Initiates unGifted characters
entries.summary: Special rules for traditions that initiate unGifted characters: the Initiation must include an Ordeal, earlier Ordeals do not count, and the Initiate cannot act as his own Mystagogue.
quotes: Initiations that affect unGifted characters must include an Ordeal

entries.title: Bload Oath of Becoming a Member of Ikhwan as-Safa'
entries.summary: Initiation Script that grants the Major Virtue Philosophical Refining with the Major Flaw Weak Elementalist Resistance, after a quest, a tractatus and a season of study.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 21
Script Bonus: +18 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sacrifice, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Ritual of Uncovering the Elemental Nature of Man
entries.summary: Initiation Script that grants a score of 1 in an Elementalist Form (chosen by the Initiate's temperament) plus the Minor Flaw Mentor.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 15
Script Bonus: +12 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus, +1 Sacrifice)

entries.title: Ritual of Making the Soul Actually Knowledgeable
entries.summary: Initiation Script that grants the Major Virtue Elemental Philosophiae and the Major Flaw Study Requirement after the supplicant writes a summa.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 21
Script Bonus: +18 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sacrifice, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Rite of Testing the Physician's Dedication
entries.summary: Initiation Script granting a score of 1 in Medicinal Divining and the Major Flaw Restriction after a year of aiding disaster victims.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 21
Script Bonus: +18 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +2 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Ritual of Discovering the Physician's Humor
entries.summary: Initiation Script in which the supplicant recovers from a Medium Wound as a pauper, then gains a score of 1 in an Elementalist Form matching his humor and the Minor Flaw Vow.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 15
Script Bonus: +11 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Ritual of Improving the Physician's Character
entries.summary: Initiation Script granting the Major Virtue Elemental Medicine and the Major Flaw Study Requirement after a year of free healing for the poor.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 21
Script Bonus: +18 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus, +1 Sacrifice)

entries.title: Rite of Opening the Mind
entries.summary: Initiation Script involving a season of fasting and prayer at Ibn Sina's tomb, with a Stamina roll, granting a score of 1 in Premonitions with the Flaw Visions.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 15
Script Bonus: +12 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +2 Sympathetic Bonus)
the player makes a Stamina roll against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Initiations for unGifted Folk Witches
entries.summary: unGifted witches are initiated by a Mystagogue who must know the power, with an Initiation Total using Presence and Theory; seven sample Scripts (Rhyme of the Beast, Venomous Darts, Sense of Place, Unbound by Land, Hands of Life, The Devil's Eye, Second Life) give the Supernatural Virtues and their ordeal Flaws.
quotes: FOLK WITCH INITIATION TOTAL: Mystagogue's Presence + Mystagogue's Folk Witch Magic Theory + Script Bonus + Sabbat Bonus
Script Bonus: +10 (+9 Major Ordeal, +1 Time)

entries.title: Fortunata's Initiations (Initiation Scripts and Quests)
entries.summary: Explains that Fortunata's written Initiation Scripts each contain Quests the Initiate must lead, how others may help or oppose, and that the Quests are only outlined as story seeds for the saga to refine.
quotes: Each of the Initiation Scripts includes one or more Quests which the Initiate must perform.

entries.title: Principles Lore (Fortunata's Organization Lore)
entries.requires: Study of Fortunata's Principles Lore texts
entries.summary: Principles Lore is an invented Organization Lore that serves as the Cult Lore for Fortunata's Initiation Scripts without any actual cult; it imposes no ranks, earlier scripts give higher Script Bonuses, and some scripts are ordered to follow a prior Ordeal.
quotes: Knowledge of this constitutes an "Organization Lore" in game terms, and acts as the "Cult Lore" for a set of Initiations with no actual cult.
Fortunata's "Cult" imposes no ranks, hierarchy or sequence of Initiations.

related.text: The Mysteries: Revised Edition p.87 Hermetic Synthemata

entries.title: How To Use A Script With No Cult
entries.summary: Explains that a magus can Initiate himself or another using an Organization Lore as the cult lore, using his own Presence, and that troupe approval is needed to repurpose an existing organization for Mysteries.
quotes: A magus can Initiate himself as easily as he can Initiate another into a Virtue he, as Mystagogue, lacks.
Each (Mystery Cult) Lore is an instance of (Organization) Lore

entries.title: Borrowing Cult Lore and Initiation Scripts (Practice Source Quality)
entries.summary: Gives the Practice Source Quality for a season spent practicing a Cult Lore, and a higher quality when the practice is inspired by another cult's ancient lore text the troupe judges compatible.
quotes: A season dedicated to Practice Cult Lore = Quality 4
A season of Practice Cult Lore inspired by ancient lore = Practice Source Quality 5

entries.title: Adapting Scripts (understanding and modifying another cult's script)
entries.requires: Mystery Cult membership and a foreign Initiation Script
entries.summary: Describes studying another cult's Initiation Script for about a week, rolling to understand it, and rolling again to modify it as if changing a script component; a botch gives a false script.
quotes: To Understand Another Cult's Script: Intelligence + (other Cult) Lore vs. 9
To Modify the Script, Change a Script Component: Intelligence + (own Cult) Lore vs. 12

entries.title: Initiation Mechanics (summary)
entries.summary: A brief summary of the Initiation process: the Mystagogue's Initiation Total is compared to a Target Level with no die roll, with different Target Levels for Minor or Major Virtues known or unknown, reductions after an Ordeal, and rules for self-initiation.
quotes: Initiation Total: Presence + (Mystery Cult) Lore + Script Bonus
To Initiate a Minor Virtue known by the Mystagogue: Target Level is 15
To Initiate a Major Virtue NOT known by the Mystagogue: Target Level is 30

entries.title: The Need To Vary A Script To Increase The Bonus
entries.requires: Mystagogue with an existing Initiation Script
entries.summary: A Mystagogue can extend an Initiation Script with a further Quest to raise its Script Bonus by passing an Intelligence + Cult Lore test.
quotes: To add a further Quest (+3 Script Bonus) to an existing Initiation Script, the Mystagogue must succeed in a test of Intelligence + (Mystery Cult) Lore against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Keeping Track Of Ordeals & The Previous-Ordeal Bonus
entries.summary: Reminds the player to record each Ordeal suffered, because it gives a Script Bonus to its own Initiation and lowers the required Initiation Total for the next three Initiations.
quotes: reduce the Initiation Total required for the next three Initiations, no matter what they are

entries.title: Multiple or Overlapping Scripts
entries.summary: When scripts share Quests or Ordeals that a self-initiate has already performed, the new script must be changed, with rolls for modifying or replacing an element; Ordeals are rarely repeatable while sacrifices are easier to repeat.
quotes: Modifying a script requires a roll of Intelligence + Cult Lore against an Ease Factor of 12; replacing a script element by a different one has an Ease factor of 15.

entries.title: Splitting Major Virtue Initiations
entries.summary: Explains the technique of gaining a Major Virtue in two stages, with an Ordeal in a preliminary Minor Virtue Initiation that lowers the Initiation Total needed for the second.
quotes: reduces the Initiation Total needed for the Major Virtue, rather than increasing the Script Bonus

entries.title: Cult of the False Kabeiros (Initiation Scripts)
entries.requires: Initiation: Cult of the False Kabeiros (Cabeiri)
entries.summary: Presents a faerie-led Cabeiri mystery cult: its degrees, the faerie mystagogue's contribution to the Initiation total, the shared Minor Ordeal Vow and holy-day bonus, and the Minor cult Virtues (Piercing Gaze, Invasive Eyes, Bright Eyes, Eyes of Theseus) with their initiation breakdowns.
quotes: The degrees of initiation in this cult are called Interrogator, Invader, Observer, and Liberator.
Each of the cult Virtues is Minor.
The Initiation Scripts assume that the mystagogue provides combined scores of 9 to the Initiation total
Invasive Eyes are not blocked by Magic Resistance, since it's an observational, rather than magical, process.

entries.title: Simplified Mystery Cult Initiation
entries.requires: Mystery cult membership; fallback if the troupe lacks Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults or The Mysteries: Revised Edition
entries.summary: Gives a quick approximation of Mystery Cult Initiation for troupes without the full rules: the Mystagogue assigns a year-long Quest, the Initiate suffers an Ordeal and gains a Virtue, guided by an Initiation Script.
quotes: During the Quest, the Initiate undergoes an Ordeal (gains a Flaw) and comes to a higher understanding of the Mystery (gains a Virtue).
The instructions for an Initiation are contained in a special Laboratory Text called an Initiation Script.

entries.title: The Temptations of Christ (Tower of the Devil ordeal)
entries.requires: Attempting an ascent of the Pyrgos Diavolou at Meteora, e.g. as a Mystery initiation ordeal
entries.summary: A forty-day ordeal on the Tower of the Devil in which the hermit faces three temptations mirroring Christ's, with fatal or Infernal consequences if he yields; suggested as an initiation ordeal.
quotes: Over the course of forty days and nights, the duration of Christ's time in the desert, he is tormented by the vultures.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal, page 85 (Infernal Blessing)

entries.title: Teacher of the House (Mystery Initiation Path)
entries.requires: Initiation into the House of the Sultan's school (mystagogue with Lore of the House)
entries.summary: Initiation scripts for the House's teaching Virtues, each with a mystagogue requirement, a ritual and a script bonus, including a debate with Seshat for Improved or Great Communication.
quotes: The mystagogue must have a (Presence + Lore of the House) total of at least 6.
This requires a Communication + Charm roll against an Ease Factor of 12

entries.title: The Initiation Process
entries.summary: Recaps how a Mystagogue rolls an Initiation Total against the script's Ease Factor, how not knowing the power raises the Ease Factor, and how The Gift affects Ordeals and self-initiation.
quotes: generates an Initiation Total equal to his Presence + Organization Lore + Script Bonus
If the Mystagogue does not personally know the power then the Ease Factor is increased by 3 (if the power is a Minor Virtue) or 9 (if the power is a Major Virtue).

entries.title: Dream Magic (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue, from a Baltic folk tradition systematized by Raisa of Novgorod, whose Mystery spells let a magus's spirit enter and act within dreams.

entries.title: Spiritual Dream Travel
entries.summary: How a spirit traveler enters a dream while the body lies in a trance: dream logic and time apply, disturbances to the body require Concentration rolls to stay, and an Arcane Connection to the body allows waking and use of real-world vis.
quotes: Physical disturbances to a traveler's body, such as being shaken or yelled at, require Concentration rolls

entries.title: The Stuff of Dreams (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar explaining that dreams are Mentem to create, enter or change from outside, but Imaginem for changes made within the dream.

entries.title: The Spiritual Traveler
entries.summary: What a spirit traveler keeps in a dream: Techniques, Imaginem as the only Form, Parma Magica, Virtues and Flaws, and a dream copy of the talisman, while the body is protected only by Form scores unless Parma is split between body and spirit.
quotes: reducing his effective Parma score by 3

entries.title: Dream Magic Spells: Duration and Target Dream
entries.summary: Introduces the new Duration: Dream and Target: Dream, which exist only for the length of one sleeper's dream, along with rules for magic and vis within dreams.
quotes: Dream Duration is equivalent to Concentration.
Dream Target is equivalent to Individual.

entries.title: Magic in Dream (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar on casting in dreams: every spell is cast as Imaginem using the magus's Imaginem score, durations run on dream time, rituals can be spontaneous with dream vis, and real-world vis is needed to affect anything beyond the dream.
quotes: A spirit traveler in a dream casts a spell of any Form as an Imaginem spell.
Real-world vis can only be used for known (non-Spontaneous) Rituals

entries.title: Dream Vis (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar saying dream vis is easily found, is nearly always Imaginem, and has no effect outside dreams; real-world vis must be carried on the body or brought by a physical traveler.

entries.title: New Spell Guidelines: Muto Mentem (Dream) (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar of Muto Mentem (Dream, Mystery) guidelines for changing a dream to include the caster's spirit, another's spirit, or a group; Range is the greater of the range to the dreamer or to the bodies involved.

entries.title: Time and Travel
entries.summary: Dream navigation is associative rather than geographical and dream time is flexible, a traveler does not sleep in a dream, and permanent changes are lost on leaving. Advice to the storyguide on running dream-logic travel.
quotes: They cannot have a dream within a dream.

entries.title: Encounters in Dream
entries.summary: What can be met in a dream: dream-people know only what the dreamer or caster intends, and a traveler may check pockets to find modest common objects, including a little dream vis, at the storyguide's discretion.
quotes: Dream-people are people as perceived by the dreamer (not the traveler).

entries.title: The Dreamer in Control (Lucid Dreaming)
entries.summary: Rolls for a dreamer to notice travelers and to reshape her own dream, with bonuses for magical power; the rolled total acts as the magnitude of a dream spell. The storyguide may also let a dreamer change the dream unconsciously.
quotes: To Become Aware of Travelers: Stress Die + Perception + Awareness vs. an Ease Factor of 9
To Reshape a Dream: Stress Die + Intelligence + Bonuses vs. an Ease Factor of 9
Dream Shaping Magnitude = Rolled Total
+3 if the dreamer has Dream Magic

entries.title: Time and Experience in Dream
entries.summary: Travelers can learn information in a dream but gain no game experience, and lab work such as inventing spells or enchanting is impossible.
quotes: they do not gain game points for Arts and Abilities

entries.title: Spell Botches in Dream
entries.summary: A botch in a dream produces nightmare effects, and gives the magus real Warping Points and Twilight checks; Twilight is measured in real-world time and removes him from the dream meanwhile.
quotes: A magus botching a spell accumulates real Warping points and must check for Twilight as normal.

entries.title: Fatigue and Wounds
entries.summary: Spirits in dreams ignore Fatigue, and wounds are not real but their shock is: the traveler rolls Stamina against the total Wound Penalty or is thrown out of the dream. Also covers attacks that reduce a traveler's Imaginem 'Might'.
quotes: Stress Die + Stamina + Modifiers vs. an Ease Factor of Total Wound Penalty
An Incapacitating wound has an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Aging in Dream
entries.summary: A spiritual traveler ages only as she chooses in a dream, while her body is subject to normal effects including aging and death; a traveler who never returns may gain a form of immortality.
quotes: While the spirit is in a dream, the body is subject to all normal effects, including aging.

entries.title: The Greater Dream Grimoire (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue, requiring Dream Magic, for entering a dream physically through a portal and for giving dream objects real substance. Physical travelers suffer real and permanent effects and perceive spiritual travelers as illusion, while they are perceived as real.
quotes: Traveling physically into dreams is like crossing into a Regio, unlike spiritual travel.

entries.title: Time, Travel, and Objects
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: Physical travelers experience normal time and movement, cannot find objects on their person, resist dream logic applied to themselves, and are expelled if the dreamer wakes; real objects hidden in a dream are easy for them to retrieve.

entries.title: Life and Limb
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: Physical travelers suffer Fatigue and Wounds, need food and sleep, and heal and age at normal rates; dream food lacks real nourishment.
quotes: Consuming dream-food is like consuming food created by magic but without vis

entries.title: Spellcasting (Greater Dream Grimoire)
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: Physical travelers cast with their normal Hermetic Forms and can cast real-world spells that affect dreams, making them much more powerful than spiritual travelers; dream aura follows the setting.
quotes: Physical travelers cast spells as normal, responding to the Forms of dream as if they had normal Hermetic Forms.

entries.title: Vis and Physical Travelers
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: Any vis can be used in a dream, but only real-world vis brought by a physical traveler has real effects and is permanently spent. Effects sustained by dream vis vanish on return, though Momentary Creo rituals create real effects.
quotes: If real-world vis is used, it is gone forever, just as if used in the real world.

entries.title: Spells of the Greater Dream Grimoire
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: States that the Range of these spells is the greater of the range to the dream target or to the people or objects affected.

entries.title: New Guidelines
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: New Mystery guidelines for the Greater Dream Grimoire: giving dream objects real substance (as a Momentary Ritual using real-world vis, with extra levels for enchantments), moving bodies and objects through a portal into dreams, plus the sample spells that use them.
quotes: Creo Imaginem spells to give substance to an object must be cast in a dream by a spiritual traveler as a Momentary Ritual, using real-world vis
Give an object encountered in dream substance so that it can exist in the real world.

entries.title: The Dream Landscape
entries.summary: Dreams have rare natural portals to the dreamer's imagination and memory, and travelers leave portals back to where they entered; any traveler, whether spiritual, physical, demon or faerie, can use dream portals.

entries.title: The Mind's Imagination
entries.summary: The imagination behaves like dream but persists into waking time, so a traveler can stay inside a waking person's mind and may confront possessing spirits that have taken residence there.
quotes: the imagination persists beyond sleep, into waking time

entries.title: The Mind's Memory
entries.summary: Rules for exploring a dreamer's memory: ordinary memories are unstructured, an Art of Memory palace can be entered like a burglar, memories can be moved or strengthened, and a solid memory can be stolen, which removes it from the dreamer.
quotes: A solid memory can be removed (stolen) into the real world.

entries.title: The Dreamscape
entries.summary: The rumored shared dreamscape between dreams: only spiritual travelers can enter, there is no direct path back to the waking world so wounds do not expel them, the body cannot be woken, and the spirit can be killed by dream Mentem and Might attacks.
quotes: This is one of the few ways to kill a magus in dreams.

entries.title: Secret Name (Minor House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer (Clan Ilfetu): Initiation of Secret Name
entries.summary: A minor House mystery that severs the sympathetic resonances of a magus's name: old Arcane Connections expire and Sympathetic Connections never work against him, though anyone who knows the secret name ignores spell level in Penetration.
quotes: All Arcane Connections to the magus which date from before the ritual immediately expire upon its completion, and all Sympathetic Connections become invalid.

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Synthemata Magic

entries.title: Initiation of Secret Name
entries.requires: House Bjornaer (Clan Ilfetu): Initiation of Secret Name
entries.summary: The initiation Ease Factor, script bonus and ritual details for the Secret Name mystery.
quotes: Ease Factor: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)
Script Bonus: +8

entries.title: The Clan Mysteries (Bjornaer)
entries.summary: Sidebar explaining that Bjornaer magi can be initiated into Clan Mysteries and House Mysteries, that each clan lists its own Initiation Scripts, and where the mechanics for those Scripts are found.

entries.title: The Mysteries of House Bjornaer (overview)
entries.summary: Overview of the layers of Bjornaer mystery, from the Outer Mystery of the Heartbeast to House, Clan and Inner Mysteries and the atavism that yields the inner heartbeast.

entries.title: Initiating the Clan Mysteries (Bjornaer)
entries.summary: Standard Initiation Ease Factor, Mystagogue requirement and the three Script templates (Trial, Deed, Oath) with their Script bonuses used by every Bjornaer clan to Initiate Clan Mysteries.
quotes: thus have an Ease Factor of 15
(Presence + House Bjornaer Lore) of at least 8

entries.title: Initiating the House Mysteries (Bjornaer)
entries.summary: House Mysteries (Heartbeast, Secret Name, Sensory Magic, Theriomorphy) are Initiated only by Clan Ilfetu, often at an ancestor site that may be perilous to reach.

entries.title: The Ritual of Twelve Years (Heartbeast initiation)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Heartbeast (Minor House Mystery)
entries.summary: The Initiation Script that grants the Heartbeast Virtue and Ability at level 1. It can never be repeated, its bonus depends on the temperaments of the witnesses, and it costs the ability to bind a familiar.
quotes: The Participation modifier provides +1 for every witness who has the same temperament as the probationer's heartbeast
Ease Factor: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)

entries.title: Secret Name (Minor House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Secret Name (Minor House Mystery)
entries.summary: A mystery that severs all sympathetic connections to the magus and gives a secret name known only to the Mystagogue and Initiate, at the cost of a minor Weak Magic Resistance. Fails if the magus has a talisman or familiar. Includes the Initiation Script.
quotes: Script Bonus: +8

entries.title: Theriomorphy (Minor House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Theriomorphy (Minor House Mystery)
entries.summary: Lets a magus apply Qualities or Virtues of his heartbeast to his human form with a roll, along with partial physical change and Warping consequences. Includes the Initiation Script.
quotes: on a Stamina + Heartbeast roll against an Ease Factor of 9
Script Bonus: +6

entries.title: Initiating the Mysteries of the Inner Heartbeast
entries.requires: House Bjornaer, Virtue: Heartbeast, House Bjornaer Lore 5+
entries.summary: The Quest to find an ancestor who became a Great Beast and win Initiation into one of the three Inner Mysteries. It is gated by Adventure experience from the Great Beast's trials and a Major Ordeal, with a full Initiation Script.
quotes: the magus must earn a total of 10 Adventure experience points from these trials
Ease Factor: 21 (Major Virtue known to the Great Beast)

entries.title: Great Beasts as Mystagogues
entries.summary: Sidebar giving the Presence and House Bjornaer Lore to use for a Great Beast acting as Mystagogue, and stating that it knows whichever Inner Mystery is sought.
quotes: Great Beasts should be considered to have a Presence of +2 and an House Bjornaer Lore of 8.

entries.title: The Mystery of the Epitome (Major House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Mystery of the Epitome (Major House Mystery)
entries.summary: Perfects the heartbeast into a Beast of Virtue with a boosted Characteristic, a Mythic Feat usable at a Confidence cost, and immunity to shape-affecting Physical Flaws.
quotes: One Characteristic of the inner heartbeast (other than Intelligence) receives a permanent +3 bonus to the value of the base animal
at a cost of 1 confidence Point

entries.title: Sample Mythic Feats
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Mystery of the Epitome
entries.summary: Sidebar giving example Mythic Feats by Characteristic for an epitome inner heartbeast.
quotes: Lift something 20 times one's own weight

entries.title: The Mystery of the Chimera (Major House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Mystery of the Chimera (Major House Mystery)
entries.summary: Transforms the heartbeast into a hybrid of two creatures, with constraints on what can be combined and a Size increase for the chimerical form.
quotes: A chimerical heartbeast is one size category larger than the outer heartbeast

entries.title: Sample Elemental Forms
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Mystery of the Anima
entries.summary: Sidebar giving game effects for stone, air, fire and water elemental inner heartbeasts, as a basis for other elements.
quotes: His Soak receives a +15 bonus, but Quickness is reduced by 5.

entries.title: The Mystery of the Anima (Major House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Mystery of the Anima (Major House Mystery)
entries.summary: Transforms the heartbeast into a spiritual or elemental creature of the same shape and size, affected by the Form associated with its element instead of Animal.

entries.title: The Inner Heartbeast in Play
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; any Inner Heartbeast Mystery
entries.summary: How to assume the inner heartbeast: change into the outer form first, then roll, taking a round. Reversing is automatic, and all features of the inner form apply together.
quotes: making a Stamina + Heartbeast roll against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Refining the Inner Heartbeast
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; any Inner Heartbeast Mystery
entries.summary: Introduces the smaller follow-on Initiations that change the Size, Characteristics, Qualities, Virtues or Powers of the inner heartbeast.

entries.title: Initiation of a Refinement
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; any Inner Heartbeast Mystery
entries.summary: The embryonic Initiation Script usable for any Refinement Mystery: a season at an ancestor site, vis consumed and a Resonant Bonus by inner-heartbeast type, with a storyguide sympathetic bonus when the Script is varied.
quotes: Script Bonus: +7 + Resonant Bonus
physically consuming one pawn of vis (of an appropriate Art) per three points of the Initiation Ease Factor

entries.title: Refinements (Inner Heartbeast)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; any Inner Heartbeast Mystery
entries.summary: The available Refinements (Changing Size, Increasing Characteristic Scores, Acquiring Qualities, Virtues and Powers) with their Ease Factors, appropriate vis, and a worked example of Initiating each.
quotes: Ease Factor 18 + (3 per previous Size increase)
Ease Factor 18 + (3 per previous increase to this Characteristic)

entries.title: Initiation of the Simple Heartbeast (Bjornaer Mystery)
entries.requires: Initiation: Bjornaer mystagogue of Clan Ilfetu (Organization Lore: Bjornaer)
entries.summary: A Clan Ilfetu initiation script that awakens a heartbeast in a character who lacks the Gift, giving the Initiate the Flaw Magical Air. It gives the Ease Factor, script bonus, regio bonus and the witness-temperament participation modifier.
quotes: Ease Factor: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)
The Initiate must not possess The Gift.

entries.title: Binding the Gift
entries.requires: Initiation: Binding the Gift (Minor House Mystery)
entries.summary: Shares the Gift's social effects with the familiar, and lets each familiar cord add to or penalise social rolls against particular types of beings.
quotes: In circumstances where more than one cord applies, use the one with the greater value.

entries.title: Spirit Familiar (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue letting a magus ally with a ghost or other incorporeal spirit as a familiar, using rules close to those for animal familiars. A magus may have only one familiar, animal or spirit; the Lab Total for binding uses a suitable Technique and Form.
quotes: A magus may only have one familiar, be it animal or spirit
The Lab Total for binding a spirit familiar is the same as an animal familiar: any appropriate Technique and any appropriate Form.

entries.title: Finding a Suitable Spirit
entries.summary: Guidance on locating and persuading a spirit to become a familiar: visit its haunts, bargain with free-willed spirits, and match its nature to the magus's best Technique and Form.

entries.title: Bonding the Ally as Spirit Familiar
entries.summary: The Lab Total, bonding level and vis cost for bonding a spirit as a familiar, with the aura modifier taken from the worse of magus or spirit.
quotes: Any Technique + Any Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura Modifier
Spirit's Might + 25
1 pawn of vis per 5 levels or fraction; which must match the Technique or Form

entries.title: Becoming Immortal with a Spirit Familiar (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar noting that a spirit familiar, already immortal, accompanies its magus through a transformation into an immortal being without needing extra vis.

entries.title: The Three Cords
entries.summary: Describes the three cords of a spirit familiar bond (Hermes, Isis and Hekate) and the extra benefits each gives, including spending the spirit's Might on Stamina rolls and transferring Might points.
quotes: Up to 5 Might points may be spent on one roll.
he can give his spirit familiar a number of Temporary Might points equal to his bond score by spending 1 level of Fatigue

entries.title: Spirit Familiar Sample Powers (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar of sample bond powers for a spirit familiar (communication, senses, location, speech, apparition, corporeality, incorporeality), with how each is built as a Hermetic effect.

entries.title: The Bonded Spirit Familiar
entries.summary: What bonding does to the spirit: mutual True Friend and Loyal traits, an Arcane Connection both ways, how Magic Resistance works, languages, and building its Characteristics from pyramid points.
quotes: You have (Might/5) pyramid points to start with, rather than the 7 points of a normal character.

entries.title: Empowering the Bond
entries.summary: States that the normal familiar rules for empowering the bond apply to a spirit familiar, including the limit on who the powers can target.

entries.title: Theurgic Spirit Familiar (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: Name-magic version of the Spirit Familiar Virtue that also lets a powerful maga ally with a Daimon, binding only one Aspect of it while the bond is with the whole Daimon.

entries.title: Finding and Binding a Daimon
entries.summary: How a magus researches, summons and wins over a Daimon as a familiar, including a rule of thumb for when it will refuse and the vis sacrifice to the Daimon.
quotes: if the (Technique + Form) proposed for the bond is less than 2 x Might, it is likely to reject the magus as not worthy
equal to its Might/5 (round up)

entries.title: Immortal Familiars: Extra Vis for Transformation
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes) with a familiar
entries.summary: A familiar can follow its magus into immortality if extra raw vis is added to the transformation rite; spirit familiars need none.
quotes: the magus must add extra raw vis to his transformation rite, equal to their Familiar Bond Score/5 (round up)

entries.title: House Merinita Society and Initiation Groups
entries.summary: Explains that House Merinita is one Mystery Cult made of many groups, that members first Initiate Faerie Magic, and that House Merinita Lore is needed to enter the Inner Mysteries.
quotes: must have at least House Merinita Lore 1 to proceed into the Inner Mysteries

entries.title: The Wayfarers (Arcadian Travel Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the Wayfarers cult, which teaches Arcadian Travel, and gives a worked sample Initiation Script with Ease Factor, script bonus and itemised script details.
quotes: Minor Virtue unknown to the Mystagogue

entries.title: Keepers of the Thousand Tales (Story Magic Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the Keepers cult, which Initiates Story Magic, Charm Magic and Becoming, with a worked sample Initiation Script for Story Magic.
quotes: Major Virtue known to the Mystagogue

entries.title: Faerie and Dreams
entries.summary: Magi with Arcadian Travel can open trods into a dream-based Arcadia, travelling in spirit while their sleeping bodies do not age or need food and water.
quotes: sleeping characters do not age or suffer ill effects of going without food or water

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Dream Virtues

entries.title: The Shadow-Masters (Glamour Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the Shadow-Masters cult and its Great Play tournament, which Initiates Glamour, Animae Magic and Perpetuity, with a worked sample Initiation Script for Glamour.
quotes: Major Virtue known to the Mystagogue

entries.title: The Cult of Vesta (Nature Lore Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the Vestal cult, its two levels of Initiation (Vestal and the later Becoming or Guardian of Nature), the Lares Lore focus of Nature Lore, and a worked sample Initiation Script.
quotes: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)

entries.title: Merinita Mysteries and Schools
entries.summary: Explains that House Merinita Mysteries are grouped into schools, that Initiating the Outer Mystery counts as belonging to the House, and how lineages and groups provide Initiation.
quotes: They maintain that if you have Initiated the Outer Mystery, you belong to their House.

entries.title: House Merinita Lore
entries.summary: The Ability used to Initiate House Merinita Mysteries, with a minimum score to enter the Inner Mysteries and typical scores for Mystagogues.
quotes: Magi who wish to Initiate the Inner Mysteries should have at least a score of 1

entries.title: The Line of Quendalon
entries.summary: Describes the lineage that Initiates the Arcadian Mysteries, with a worked sample Initiation Script for Animae Magic.
quotes: 21 (Major Virtue known to the Mystagogue)

entries.title: Heirs to Merlin (Charm Magic Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the lineage that Initiates Charm Magic, Story Magic and later Symbolic Magic, with a worked sample Initiation Script for Charm Magic.
quotes: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)

entries.title: The Followers of Pendule (Spell Timing Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the lineage that Initiates Spell Timing and Glamour, and a worked sample Initiation Script with Ease Factor, script bonus and Flaw Ordeals.
quotes: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)

entries.title: The True Merinitae (Wilding Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the lineage that Initiates the nature Mysteries and gives a worked sample Initiation Script for Wilding.
quotes: 21 (Major Virtue known to the Mystagogue)

entries.title: Living Ghost (Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: The Major Mystery in which a magus binds his spirit to an area before a ritual death and becomes a free-willed ghost who keeps his abilities. It is done through invented Mystery Ritual spells; Hermetic legal protection is lost at death.

entries.title: Preparing for the Transformation
entries.summary: The magus must invent personal versions of two Mystery Ritual spells, Bind the Living Ghost and Transformation of the Living Ghost, as the lab preparation for the Ordeal.

entries.title: Bind The Living Ghost (Mystery Ritual)
entries.summary: The Mystery Ritual that defines the magus's Haunt, the area his ghost is bound to. The design level depends on the area Target chosen, and the levels spent enlarging the area feed into the Transformation spell.
quotes: Cr(Pe/Re)Me(Co) (30 + area Size)
(Base 30, + magnitudes to increase area from Individual)

entries.title: Transformation of the Living Ghost (Mystery Ritual)
entries.summary: The unique general-level Mystery Ritual that sets a Living Ghost's Might Score, capped by a transformation limit from his best Technique and Form and reduced by the levels reserved for the size of the Haunt.
quotes: Transformation Limit = Best Technique and Form Combination
Size Levels = Levels Added to Increase Target of Bind the Living Ghost
Might Score = Ritual Spell Level – Size Levels

entries.title: A Living Ghost
entries.summary: How the Ordeal is performed (cast Transformation, then Bind), that it can be attempted only once, and what a Living Ghost is like afterwards: self-aware, able to learn with difficulty, tied to its Haunt, and still linked to its talisman.

entries.title: Hazards of Becoming a Living Ghost (sidebar)
entries.requires: Initiation: Living Ghost; Virtue: Inscription on the Soul
entries.summary: Sidebar on the danger of a body-linked talisman: destroying the body breaks its attunements and gives Warping Points as a single event, and entering Twilight mid-process means the Ritual fails.

entries.title: Learning and the Immortal Spirit
entries.summary: An immortal, unaging spirit resists study and learning; a Living Ghost can get round this by enchanting his talisman as described for immortal magi.

entries.title: Familiars and the Living Ghost
entries.summary: A spirit familiar stays with its magus automatically; another familiar can join him in living death if the magus spends extra raw vis based on the bond score.
quotes: provided the magus expends additional pawns of raw vis equal to the Familiar Bond Score/5 (round up)

related.text: Appendix A: Immortal Magi, Becoming Immortal with a Familiar

entries.title: The Haunt
entries.summary: Explains that a Living Ghost depends on its Haunt continuing to exist, and compares the stability of Circle, Room, Structure and Boundary Targets.

entries.title: Magic and the Living Ghost
entries.summary: The Might powers a Living Ghost uses (Ghostly Body, Ghostly Magic, Ghostly Vis), how Fatigue and unconsciousness still affect it, and what happens when its Might runs out.
quotes: by spending 1 point of Temporary Might per magnitude of the effect
the Living Ghost can permanently expend points of Might Score, with each point equivalent to one pawn of raw vis

entries.title: Manipulating the World as a Ghost
entries.summary: How an insubstantial Living Ghost acts on the world: using Rego spells and enchanted devices, possessing bodies, working in a lab, and the penalty of being forced out of a body away from the Haunt.

entries.title: Re-Enchanting the Spirit
entries.requires: Initiation: Living Ghost; Virtue: Inscription on the Soul
entries.summary: A Living Ghost who spent Might Score as vis can restore or increase it by opening unused talisman spaces and recasting Transformation of the Living Ghost; the Might Score stays capped by the Technique and Form limit.

entries.title: Mystery Cult: The Followers of Pendule
entries.requires: House Merinita: Followers of Pendule lineage
entries.summary: A Merinita lineage descended from the wizard Pendule whose followers usually Initiate Spell Timing and Glamour, favor Imaginem, and are weak to iron.
quotes: Followers of Pendule usually Initiate Spell Timing and Glamour

entries.title: Sample Followers of Pendule Initiation: Spell Timing
entries.requires: House Merinita: Followers of Pendule lineage
entries.summary: The Ease Factor, script bonus and ordeal for initiating the Spell Timing mystery, which brings three Minor Flaws.
quotes: Ease Factor: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)
Script Bonus: +12

entries.title: Spell Timing (Minor Illusion Mystery)
entries.summary: Gives access to new Durations (Held, Midday/Midnight, Season, While, Not, If) that hold, delay or trigger a spell, and to recurring spells that trigger repeatedly in response to a condition.
quotes: Held (Duration): This duration is the same level as Concentration.
To determine the level, you should add four magnitudes to the level calculated based on the Duration that the spell has when it takes effect

entries.title: Recurring Spells
entries.summary: Table of magnitudes added to a spell's level according to how often it recurs, from once a minute to once a decade.
quotes: Spells cannot recur more often than once per minute.

entries.title: Faerie Magic Ability
entries.summary: Arcane Ability gained by Merinita who Initiate Faerie Magic; it enables charms and can substitute for Magic Theory in some lab work with faerie vis, with its own vis limit and botch-dice effects.
quotes: Faerie Magic may be substituted for Magic Theory when experimenting, when using faerie vis, or when practicing magic associated with the Faerie realm.
The amount of vis you can use in a single season is equal to your (Magic Theory + Faerie Magic) x 2, so long as all of it is faerie vis.
Add your score in Faerie Magic to the number of botch dice you roll in these conditions

entries.title: Charms
entries.summary: Charms are symbolic casting aids made with an artistic Ability that, with an Arcane Connection, boost Penetration; temporary and permanent charms differ in time, target roll and reuse.
quotes: increasing her Penetration multiplier by two
The maga produces an effective charm on a roll of six or more, or nine or more for a permanent charm.

entries.title: Charm Magic
entries.summary: Lets a maga build charms into particular spells for Casting Total bonuses per charm and category, boost Penetration with an Arcane Connection, and combine concepts into one charm.
quotes: A single charm imparts a +2 bonus to the Casting Total of the spell.
Casting Total Bonus: +1 for each charm, +1 for each category represented
Sympathetic Connection Bonus: +2, +1 for each category beyond the first

entries.title: Charm Categories
entries.summary: The six categories of charm (adage, aspect, character, event, item, place) used to count category bonuses with Charm Magic.

entries.title: Story Magic
entries.summary: A maga designs story charms and spends a confidence Point to make the storyguide work the charm's concept into the narrative, or substitutes story charms as wild cards in Charm Magic spells.
quotes: Then she rolls the associated Characteristic + Ability against an Ease Factor of 9.
assume the character has a +3 bonus on all rolls associated with the charm for the entire scene

entries.title: Symbolic Magic
entries.summary: Lab activities using charms: charm bonuses to invested devices and talismans, permanent charms others can use, and ritual spells with Symbol Range, Duration and Target.
quotes: adding double the charm and category bonuses to her Lab Total instead of her Casting Total
this requires Faerie Magic 3 and a Characteristic + Ability roll against an Ease Factor of 12 to design the symbol

entries.title: Symbol Range, Duration and Target
entries.summary: New ritual-only Range, Duration and Target that use a symbol as an Arcane Connection, last as long as the symbol, or affect all targets the symbol represents.
quotes: It is the same level as Year, and requires a ritual to cast.
It is calculated at the same level as Boundary, though it is essentially a large Group

entries.title: The Paths Through the Forest
entries.requires: Forest Lore; communion with a genius locus
entries.summary: Introduces the idea of walking solitary paths to the primal power of the forests, which can overcome Lesser Limits of Hermetic magic but is dangerous and has no teacher except in a few cases.
quotes: each path must be walked alone, and it is easy to become lost

entries.title: The First Step: Gaining Forest Lore
entries.requires: Spending time in a supernatural forest
entries.summary: The first step on a forest path is spending time in a supernatural forest to learn the Forest Lore Ability, using the aura as Source Quality, which can happen without the character knowing it.
quotes: the Source Quality is the strength of the aura in which the student spends most of his time
Once this Ability reaches a score of at least 1, the character has reached the level of understanding which will allow him to find the path that he wishes to travel.

entries.title: Walking the Path: Communion, Sacrifice and Fruit
entries.summary: How a character finds a path and enters communion with a genius locus, forming a pact in game terms: a Flaw (the Sacrifice) is taken first and, after a Quest, a Virtue (the Fruit) is gained to balance it.
quotes: Intelligence + Forest Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 9, one attempt per season
In game terms, at the conclusion of the communion, the character will acquire a Flaw (termed the Sacrifice).

entries.title: Sacrifices on the Forest Paths
entries.requires: Forest Lore; communion with a genius locus
entries.summary: Guidance for choosing the Flaw taken as the Sacrifice of a forest path, with typical examples and a reminder that it needs the player's consent.
quotes: Sacrifices are not a manifestation of a forest spirit's Grant Flaw power, but instead permanent changes to those who take them on.

entries.title: Quests on the Forest Paths
entries.requires: Forest Lore; communion with a genius locus
entries.summary: Explains that a Quest is a task with a clear end set by the genius locus to earn a Fruit, that the questing character gains no experience from it, and how Major quests compare with Minor ones.
quotes: A character undertaking a Quest will not gain any experience points for doing so
Quests for a Minor Virtue typically take no more than two seasons.

entries.title: Fruits of the Forest Paths
entries.summary: Explains that a Fruit is a permanent supernatural effect, usually a Virtue that unGifted characters can also gain, and advises storyguides on linking and inventing Virtues for a path.
quotes: Fruits are not a manifestation of the Grant Virtue power, they are permanent effects which do not fade when exiting the forest.

entries.title: The Path of Aging
entries.requires: Forest Lore; communion with a genius locus
entries.summary: An example forest path that yields longevity effects, listing its two Sacrifices, Quests and Fruits and including the Immortality of the Forest Virtue that replaces Aging rolls with Warping.
quotes: For each year in which you remain completely within its supernatural aura, you do not make an Aging roll, but instead gain one Warping Point

entries.title: The Path of Energy
entries.requires: Forest Lore; communion with a genius locus
entries.summary: An example forest path for drawing energy from the forest to replenish a magus, with its two Sacrifices, Quests and Fruits.

entries.title: The Path of Warping
entries.requires: Forest Lore; communion with a genius locus
entries.summary: An example forest path built on mastering Warping, including the Twilight Mastery Virtue that lets a magus choose his Twilight effects and inflict Warping, and the Sacrifices, Quests and Fruits of the path.
quotes: once per day you may grant somebody 2 Warping Points
This effect has a Penetration of +5

entries.title: The Path of the Heartbeast
entries.summary: Describes the Bjornaer heartbeast as a forest path overcoming the Limit of Essential Nature, whose price is that the magus can never bind a familiar.
quotes: The sacrifice for this power is the inability to ever bind a familiar.

entries.title: The Arcadian Path
entries.requires: Forest Lore; Mystery of Faerie Magic
entries.summary: A forest path through Arcadia that lets a Merinita-style magus partly overcome the Limit of True Feeling, including the Dispassionate Personality Flaw, the Thief of Emotions Virtue with its Emotion Theft roll, and the path's Sacrifices, Quests and Fruits.
quotes: You cannot have a Personality Trait greater than +1 or less than –1.
You may then make a Presence + Emotion Theft roll against an Ease Factor of 6 + the target's Personality Trait for that emotion.

related.text: ArM5 p.92 Mystery of Faerie Magic

entries.title: Gifted Gruagach Initiations
entries.summary: Explains how Gifted gruagachan Initiate students into additional supernatural Abilities via Scripts, with the Initiation Total formula and notes on mystagogues, written scripts and self-initiation.
quotes: Presence + Gruagach Lore + Script Bonus

entries.title: Ritual of Calling the Fetch
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Fetch Virtue: a fasting vigil on a mountaintop, the Stamina plus Concentration rolls required, how the fetch animal is chosen, and the Restriction gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +13 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +1 Sympathetic)
The player must succeed in a Stamina + Concentration roll against an Ease Factor of 9 on three consecutive attempts.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.19 Choosing the Heartbeast

entries.title: Extractions of the Soul from its Husk
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the External Soul Virtue: prerequisites such as a Vow to train apprentices and a vessel stone, a season-long ritual, and the Flaw gained.
quotes: Initiation Ease Factor: 21/30

entries.title: UnGifted Gruagach Initiations
entries.summary: Explains how unGifted gruagachan gain each Art through an independent Initiation Script in any order, with no self-Initiation, and the usual progression of Arts.
quotes: an unGifted gruagach may not self-Initiate any Arts

entries.title: Initiation into the Give Technique
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Give Technique, a quest for justice followed by training, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +17 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Take Technique
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Take Technique, a sacrifice at a place of worship followed by training, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +17 (+3 Special Place, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Sacrifice, +1 Initiate's Time)

entries.title: Initiation into the Blessing Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Blessing Form, requiring a permanent solution for a truly disadvantaged person, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +11 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Curse Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Curse Form, punishing a wicked individual with a poetically just penalty, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +11 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Shape Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Shape Form, defeating a shapechanger and being transformed into its shape for a lunar month, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +11 (+3 Quest, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Vision Form
