entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Vision Form, a fast and meditation at a Pictish holy site with Concentration rolls, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: The player must succeed in a Stamina + Concentration roll against an Ease Factor of 9 on three consecutive attempts.

entries.title: Synthemata (sidebar)
entries.requires: Virtue: Hermetic Synthemata or Synthemata Magia
entries.summary: Sidebar explaining that synthemata are signs, symbols or passwords linking a magician to a spirit; most theurgic spells merely include them, but special Virtues let a magus use them as a channel to command spirits.

entries.title: Hermetic Synthemata (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue where a magus learns a being's synthemata, unique to it, as a key to boost Penetration past its Magic Resistance; useful for summoning Daimons but it makes the being ill-disposed.
quotes: Any being with a Might score has synthemata.

entries.title: Synthemata of (X)
entries.summary: Mystery spell unique to one named being whose level must equal or exceed that being's Might; it adds its level to the Penetration Total of the next spell cast.
quotes: the caster adds the synthemata level to the Penetration Total of any spell cast (or begun) immediately after the synthemata spell

entries.title: The Lasting Synthemata of (X)
entries.summary: Diameter-duration version of the synthemata spell that gives a Penetration bonus of its level reduced by a fixed amount for multiple castings, and makes the being aware of the threat.
quotes: the (spell level – 5) must equal or exceed its Might

entries.title: Researching Synthemata (Hermetic)
entries.summary: Lab rules for inventing a synthemata spell: the base level must reach the target's Might, (Realm) Lore replaces Magic Theory, sympathetic connections add bonuses, and name hiding reduces seasonal progress.
quotes: Lab Total = Muto + Vim + Intelligence + (Realm) Lore + Aura + Bonuses
Spell Points Accumulated = (Lab Total – Spell Level – Name Hiding)
Typical Name Hiding = (Might / 2)

entries.title: Revealing Synthemata
entries.summary: A commanded powerful spirit may reveal the synthemata of spirits it controls, which lets the magus skip name hiding when researching them; includes a guideline for how many a spirit knows.
quotes: assume a powerful spirit may know synthemata of other spirits whose Might Scores add up to no more than its own Might, and no individual higher than its own Might/2

entries.title: Synthemata Magia (Major Supernatural Mystery Ability)
entries.summary: A non-Hermetic Major Supernatural Ability, predecessor of Hermetic synthemata research, that uses (Realm) Lore and lets a magus intuit a being's synthemata quickly at the cost of a weaker effect.

entries.title: Intuit Synthemata
entries.summary: Roll of Perception plus (Realm) Lore against the being's Might and name hiding, adjusted by auras, to intuit a being's synthemata in its presence; success gives a personal Muto Vim guideline to boost Casting Score against it, and botches alert the spirit.
quotes: Stress Die + Perception + (Realm) Lore + Magus's Aura Modifier vs. Might + Spirit's Aura Modifier + Name Hiding
Add spell level to the caster's Casting Score for spells cast while this spell lasts.

entries.title: The Hedge Lord's Synthemata of (X)
entries.summary: Spell template for the Synthemata Magia version of a synthemata spell, adding a reduced level to Casting Score against one named being for a short Diameter.
quotes: The spell adds its (level – 5) to the caster's Casting Score against the named being for two minutes.

entries.title: Researching Synthemata (Synthemata Magia)
entries.summary: A season of fasting and invocation lets a Synthemata Magia user learn the synthemata of a being previously met in person, by an Ability roll against its Might plus name hiding; failure does not bar further tries.
quotes: Stress Die + Perception + (Realm) Lore + Aura Modifier + Bonuses vs. Might + Name Hiding

gated.title: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes

entries.title: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes (Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes (prerequisite: Hermetic Theurgy)
entries.summary: A Major Mystery path to apotheosis, requiring Hermetic Theurgy, in which a hierarch devises two non-Hermetic Mystery Rituals that a group of celebrants must cast for him. No Warping is inflicted for the high level since the spells are for one magus.

entries.title: Ascendant Form of the Intendant Hierarch
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: The hierarch's own Mystery Ritual that manifests his abilities at their strongest. The level is at least the total of his best Technique and Form, and the resulting Might is half the Ritual level; celebrants must overcome his full Magic Resistance.
quotes: the ascended hierarch will have a Might of (this Ritual's level/2)
a minimum level of 40

entries.title: Familiars and the Ascendant Magus (sidebar)
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: Sidebar: a spirit familiar automatically ascends with its magus, while another familiar can join him if extra vis based on the bond score is spent in the Ritual.
quotes: provided additional pawns of raw vis equal to the Familiar Bond Score/5 (round up) are expended in the Ritual

related.text: Appendix A: Immortal Magi, Becoming Immortal with a Familiar

entries.title: Transformation of the Ascendant Hierarch
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: The celebrants' Ordeal Ritual cast on the hierarch; it must beat his Magic Resistance and exceed the Ascendant Form level, and the hierarch rolls Stamina against an Ease Factor to avoid passing out.
quotes: The hierarch makes a Stamina roll against an Ease Factor of 9, or passes out

entries.title: The Cumulative Transformation Process
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: How transformation points accumulate over repeated rituals and the total needed, which adds the Ascendant Form level and extra points for negative Characteristics, Decrepitude and excess Flaws.
quotes: Count Major Flaws and Virtues as 3 points each, Minor as 1 point each.
Flaws are Excessive if Flaws Exceed Virtues.
Level + 3 x cost of Negative Characteristics + 5 x Decrepitude + 5 x Flaw Points if Excessive

entries.title: Ascension
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: What happens at ascension: the magus becomes an immortal spirit that can be summoned, his talisman becomes part of his being, and his body is left as an Arcane Connection.

entries.title: Invoke the Pact of (Daimon): Daimonic Magus Summoned (sidebar)
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: Sidebar: a player-character Daimonic magus can be summoned by an Invoke Pact spell devised for him, earning pact benefits in exchange for a service; the Daimon gains a benefit tied to the spell level.
quotes: The spirit gains the benefit when the Invocation points total equals his Might, and he is called to appear.

entries.title: The Daimonic Magus
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: Describes the ascended Daimonic magus: Aspects in several places, immunity to aging and Warping, no laboratory use, and no Fatigue levels (Might is spent instead of Fatigue).
quotes: the Daimon expends 5 Might for each Fatigue level normally expended

entries.title: Learning and Improving as a Daimonic Spirit
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: Daimon Points earned from pact summonings let a Daimonic magus fix study and spell experience, raise Might and Characteristics, and trade for lessons with other spirits.
quotes: Daimon Points = (spell level) / 5
5 Daimon Points can be used to increase Might Score by 1 point.

entries.title: Structure of the Cult of Dedun
entries.summary: Describes how the Cult of Dedun is organised into districts under temple priests, that its Mysteries are aligned to the Magic realm, and what its members seek.
quotes: The Cult of Dedun is a Mystery Cult.
its Mysteries are aligned to the Magic realm rather than that of Faerie

entries.title: Cult of Dedun: Adherent
entries.requires: Cult of Dedun, rank of Adherent
entries.summary: Explains who the cult's Adherents are, what is required of them, and how the cult's Prohibition protects its secrecy.
quotes: relying on the cult's Prohibition (gained upon Initiation to the rank of adherent) to maintain secrecy

entries.title: Initiation Script: Adherent of Dedun
entries.requires: Cult of Dedun, rank of Adherent
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the lowest rank, which grants no Virtue but binds the Initiate with the Prohibition Flaw; also covers the aging-Crisis-like penalty for breaking it.
quotes: Violating the cult's Prohibition causes Dedun's Shadow to pass over the oathbreaker.

entries.title: Cult of Dedun: Altar Priest
entries.requires: Cult of Dedun, rank of Altar Priest
entries.summary: Describes the duties and Ability requirements of altar priests and how they trade their Prohibition for a Vow.
quotes: Altar priests are expected to have an Organization Lore: Cult of Dedun of 1 or more, and a Meroitic of at least 3 to perform the rites to Dedun.

entries.title: Initiation Script: Altar Priest of Dedun (Dedun's Blessing)
entries.requires: Cult of Dedun, rank of Altar Priest
entries.summary: Initiation Script that grants Dedun's Blessing, letting the character align Magic auras toward the dead through yearly ceremonies and an Intelligence + Magic Lore roll.
quotes: The level of the aura is doubled when the activity matches the alignment
You may then make a roll of Intelligence + Magic Lore + stress die against an Ease Factor of (9+aura level).

entries.title: Cult of Dedun: Temple Priest and the Court of the Dead
entries.requires: Cult of Dedun, rank of Temple Priest
entries.summary: Rank requirements and duties of temple priests, including how they build a court of prepared corpses and how the court's strength is totalled from the Reputations of its members.
quotes: To be considered for this rank, a character must have an Organization Lore: Cult of Dedun of at least 3, and knowledge of Meroitic at 4 or more.
Each member of the court contributes the highest Reputation that it had in life to the total strength of the court, with a minimum of 1.

entries.title: Initiation Script: Temple Priest of Dedun (Unnatural Vitality)
entries.requires: Cult of Dedun, rank of Temple Priest
entries.summary: Initiation Script that grants Unnatural Vitality, turning Decrepitude into a bonus to Casting and Laboratory Totals and softening the effects of old age.
quotes: She gains a bonus to all Casting Totals and Laboratory Totals equal to (3 x Decrepitude Score).

entries.title: Cult of Dedun: The Undying Ones
entries.requires: Cult of Dedun, rank of Undying One
entries.summary: Prerequisites for the final rank, how it turns a Gifted initiate into a Magic Human, and how the corpse-court substitutes for a Magic aura to stave off Acclimation.
quotes: Furthermore, the sum of the character's Warping Score and Decrepitude Score must equal or exceed 7.
The court substitutes for a Magic aura of a level equal to one tenth (or fraction) of the total strength.

entries.title: Initiation Script: Undying One (Transformed Human)
entries.requires: Cult of Dedun, Temple Priest with The Gift (self-initiation)
entries.summary: Initiation Script that makes the character a Magic Human with Might bought from the court's strength, removes ageing and Warping, and imposes a year-long ritual and the loss of The Gift.
quotes: You can raise this Might above the base using the total strength of the character's court, buying Might Score as if it were an Art.

entries.title: Fraternity of Samos: Structure and Entry Requirements
entries.summary: Describes the Pythagorean cult's strict degree system and its unusual mundane Ability prerequisites for a first Initiation, which also add a bonus to the Initiation Script.
quotes: it is required that the prospective probationer can pass examinations in philosophiae and artes liberales, which can be represented by having attained a score of 3 in both those abilities
represented by a score of 1 in Music
confer a +1 bonus to the Initiation Script employed

entries.title: Samos Degree: Mathematicus
entries.summary: First Akousmatic degree; requires a minimum score in Artes Liberales (Mathematics) and teaches the Virtue Hermetic Numerology.
quotes: possessing at least a score of 3 in Artes Liberales (Mathematics)

entries.title: Samos Degree: Theoreticus
entries.summary: Second degree; requires a higher Artes Liberales (Geometry) score and a Numerologist's Book, and teaches the Virtue Hermetic Geometry.
quotes: possessing at least a score of 4 in Artes Liberales (Geometry)

entries.title: Samos Degree: Electus
entries.summary: Third degree; teaches Planetary Magic. The Initiators keep a natal chart and a permanent Arcane Connection to the Initiate, giving casters against the Initiate a Penetration bonus; this counts as an Ordeal.
quotes: a bonus of eight times Penetration score when casting spells against the Initiate
constitutes an Ordeal for Initiation

entries.title: Samos Inner Order: Mathematikoi
entries.summary: Describes the Inner Order's duties: minimum Teaching, hosting visitors, and training apprentices, which can serve as a Sacrifice in later Initiation Scripts.
quotes: Members of the Mathematikoi must possess the mundane ability Teaching at a score of at least 2
conferring a +6 bonus for the 15 seasons sacrificed

entries.title: Samos Degree: Tertius, or 3=4
entries.summary: Fourth degree; teaches the geometry of the elemental solids and the Virtue Hermetic Architecture, with other Virtues rumored.
quotes: the Virtue Hermetic Architecture is now Initiated

entries.title: Samos Degree: Secundus, or 2=5
entries.summary: Fifth degree; rumored to teach Inscription on the Soul, Hermetic Theurgy or Theurgic Spirit Familiar.
quotes: It is rumored that some Initiates learn the mystery of the Virtue Inscription on the Soul

entries.title: Samos Degree: Pythagorean, or True Initiate
entries.summary: Final degree; a five-year vow of silence counts as a Major Ordeal for Initiation Script purposes, and the Virtue taught is uncertain.
quotes: this counts as a Major Ordeal for Initiation Script purposes

entries.title: Immortal Magi: General Rules
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Common rules for magi who have become immortal beings of the Magic realm: Might, no Aging, Warping or Twilight, and a natural reversion to stasis that must be countered by binding changes into a talisman.
quotes: An immortal ceases to make Aging rolls — he truly does not age — and is beyond the effects of Warping and Twilight.
A being with a Might score is subject to Warding spells, including Aegis of the Hearth

entries.title: Immortals: Permanent Change and the Talisman
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Explains how an immortal who keeps a talisman can bind learning into it, no longer limited in opening spaces by Technique and Form, and notes that Ordeals cannot be used for Initiation of immortals.
quotes: A maga who becomes immortal in one of these ways is no longer limited by her highest Technique and Form in the number of spaces she can open in her talisman
Ordeals cannot be used for Initiation of immortal beings

entries.title: Immortals: Learning Arts or Abilities
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Experience gained by an immortal fades over the next season unless a season is spent enchanting the talisman to bind it; includes a worked example.
quotes: The Effect level needed is 10 x XP to be retained.
She has a Creo Mentem lab total of 90, and can invest a level 45 effect in one season.

entries.title: Binding the Immortal Memory (Enchantment)
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Mystery enchantment guideline that binds a study period's experience into the talisman; the effect level required is tied to the experience points to retain and must be done in one season.
quotes: The Effect level needed is 10 x XP to be retained.
The effect must be completed in one season or all new experience points will be lost to the repair effect.

entries.title: Immortals: Learning Spells
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: A spell learned by an immortal fades from memory over the season unless bound into the talisman by enchantment.
quotes: The magus can bind the knowledge of a spell by creating an enchantment in his talisman.

entries.title: The Immortal's Grimoire (Enchantment)
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Mystery enchantment guideline that lets the talisman hold the knowledge of a spell as an always-on memory, so the spell is cast normally with full Casting Total and Penetration.
quotes: The invested effect level must equal the level of spell to be retained.
by casting the spell normally the magus uses his full Casting Total, gets full Penetration (Casting Total – Spell level + Penetration Bonus), and has unlimited uses per day

entries.title: Immortals: Binding High-Level Spells over Several Seasons
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Multi-season procedure alternating relearning a spell and investing it, with a Magic Theory roll to ensure the relearned spell matches and a botch table for failures.
quotes: He must succeed in a roll of Intelligence + Magic Theory against an Ease Factor of 6 + the magnitude of the spell.
To match each partial spell-binding, roll a stress die + Intelligence + Magic Theory vs. (6 + Magnitude of Spell).

entries.title: Immortals: Unchanging Nature, Healing and Mental Changes
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Sidebar giving how temporary changes, wounds and mental effects fade for immortals, with weekly Recovery rolls, thresholds by wound level, and a table matching spell levels to healing rates.
quotes: Any Temporary, Unbound Change will Fade Completely over a Season.
Recovery Total: Simple Die + Stamina + Medic's Chirurgy or Medicine Score + Magical Aid
Improve if Recovery Total is 10+ (Light Wounds), 12+ (Medium Wounds), 15+ (Heavy Wounds)

entries.title: Inscription on the Soul (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue letting a magus make his own spirit and body his talisman, opened with vis and attuned over a season. A magus may have only one talisman at a time.
quotes: The magus's spirit and body are opened initially with 15 pawns of vis

entries.title: Enchantment and Magical Attunements
entries.summary: Benefits of the soul talisman: the usual talisman Lab Total bonus, effect expiry treated as seventy years, and a limited range of Shape and Material Bonuses from the human body.
quotes: A magus gains the usual talisman bonus of +5 to Lab Total for enchantments to his talisman

related.text: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material Bonuses

entries.title: Hermetic Empowerment and Inscription on the Soul (sidebar)
entries.requires: Virtue: Inscription on the Soul and Hermetic Empowerment
entries.summary: Sidebar on combining the two Virtues: binding a spirit into the magus's own body or spirit, and triggering Ritual effects from it, each inflict a Warping Point.

entries.title: Spirit vs. Body Enchantments
entries.summary: Explains when it matters whether an enchantment is placed in the spirit or the body (default is spirit; body if Shape and Material Bonuses from the body or Blending With Substance are used).

entries.title: Blending with Substance
entries.summary: How a magus embeds a small item in his flesh to attune its Shape and Material bonuses: an effect level is calculated from the item's bonuses, a Rego Vim effect with requisites is enchanted, and Warping Points are inflicted.
quotes: Total the highest bonus, and half the sum of any other bonuses, and multiply by 5 to get an effect level.

entries.title: The Great or Consummate Talisman (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar comparing Blending with Substance to the Great Talisman Virtue and noting it does not allow attuning new bonuses without working on the talisman.

entries.title: Vulgar Alchemy and Blending With Substance (sidebar)
entries.requires: Virtue: Inscription on the Soul; Initiation: Hermetic Alchemy
entries.summary: Sidebar saying Shape and Material items found by Vulgar Alchemy must be fully integrated into Hermetic theory (a tractatus) before they can be used in Blending With Substance.

entries.title: Talisman Connection
entries.summary: Describes how the magus's body and spirit remain connected and mutually Arcane Connections if separated, and how enchantments in each can be removed.

entries.title: Initiation of Puissant Principles Lore
entries.summary: Fortunata's script for gaining Puissant Principles Lore, with its Quests, Vow, vis sacrifice and the Initiation Total and Script Bonus breakdown.
quotes: Initiation Total 18, Script Bonus 16

entries.title: Initiation of Spirit Familiar
entries.summary: Fortunata's adapted Greek script for gaining the Spirit Familiar Virtue, built around Quests to rescue the spirit and defeat its enemy and a place and time of significance.
quotes: Initiation Total 18, Script Bonus 12

entries.title: Initiation of Minor Magical Focus (commanding spirits)
entries.requires: Initiation Script: Minor Magical Focus (commanding spirits)
entries.summary: Script for the Minor Magical Focus covering Rego spells that command spirits, which involves an Ordeal imposing the Necessary Condition Flaw of speaking spirit names.
quotes: Initiation Total 18, Script Bonus 12

entries.title: Speaking the Names of Spirits (Necessary Condition)
entries.requires: Necessary Condition from the Minor Magical Focus Ordeal
entries.summary: Describes the practical effect of the condition (spells must be cast aloud, with recognizable invocations) and how the Ordeal detail can be varied, with an Intelligence + Principles Lore roll.
quotes: requires an Intelligence + Principles Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 12

entries.title: Initiation of Major Magical Focus (spirit magic)
entries.requires: Initiation Script: Major Magical Focus (spirit magic); an existing Minor Magical Focus
entries.summary: Script converting a Minor Magical Focus into a Major Focus in spirit magic through defeating two strong spirits, relying on the Ordeal reduction from the earlier script.
quotes: Initiation Total 21 (30 – 9 for previous Ordeal), Script Bonus 13

entries.title: Initiation of Spell Binding
entries.summary: Fortunata's script for the Spell Binding Virtue, involving forcing a spirit into a glass ball to sustain a light spell in a deep cave.
quotes: Initiation Total 12 (18 – 6 for previous Ordeal), Script Bonus 6

entries.title: Initiation of Hermetic Empowerment
entries.summary: Fortunata's script for Hermetic Empowerment, in which a device is enchanted in a graveyard with vis from destroyed ghosts and then burned at a pyre on a quarter-day.
quotes: Initiation Total 18, Script Bonus 9

entries.title: Hermetic Geometry (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue built on Euclid's postulates and Artes Liberales (geometry) that provides sympathetic magic through shapes, adding perfect-shape drawing, casting bonuses for figures, and new Line Range and Arcane Circle and Ring Targets.

entries.title: Drawing a Perfect Shape (sidebar)
entries.summary: Rules for scribing a perfect circle or other shape, needed for Arcane Circle and Arcane Ring: a Scribe roll with a hard Ease Factor freehand or an easier one with posts and string, plus the pace and Concentration limits while tracing.
quotes: Die Roll + Dexterity + Profession: Scribe vs. an Ease Factor of 15 if drawn freehand
Die Roll + Dexterity + Profession: Scribe vs. an Ease Factor of 6 if drawn with the aid of posts and string.

entries.title: Bonus for Circles, Rings, and Lines
entries.summary: A Casting Score bonus when a spell involves tracing a circle or line, including standard Circle and Ring spells.
quotes: the magus gains a bonus of +3 to his Casting Score

entries.title: Ceremonial Figures
entries.summary: Ceremonial Casting, even for Formulaic spells, with geometric and numerological figures gives a further Casting Score bonus that stacks with the circle bonus; describes which rooms and structures count as regular and the components needed for higher-magnitude spells.
quotes: may use Ceremonial Casting (even for Formulaic spells) and include complex Geometric and Numerological correspondences to gain a bonus of +3 to the Casting Score

entries.title: New Range: Line
entries.summary: New Range: Line, equivalent to Sight but needing only that the target be sensed. The magus must calculate the distant point with a Geometry roll against an Ease Factor from the Distance Level, taking rounds to scribe it; failure shifts the target.
quotes: Ease Factor = Distance Level (minimum 9)
Die Roll + Intelligence + Artes Liberales (Arithmetic) vs. Ease Factor
Time Taken = (Ease Factor / 3) Rounds (round up)

entries.title: Distance Level table (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar table converting a distance in paces into a Distance Level, used as the Ease Factor for Line Range calculations.
quotes: Treat the length of the line in paces as if points to purchase a score in an Ability.

entries.title: New Target: Arcane Circle and New Duration: Arcane Ring
entries.summary: New Target Arcane Circle and new Duration Arcane Ring let a magus cast a circle spell on a remote circle by tracing a perfect circle she can reach; the spell breaks if either circle is broken, and the centre is located like a Line Range.
quotes: The line traced must be a perfect circle (as opposed to the standard Circle Target).

entries.title: Daimons (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar defining Daimons as ancient named spirits that appear through an Aspect; magi summon only an Aspect and cannot truly threaten the Daimon. A magus must know something of a Daimon, or hold a Lab Text, to create a summoning spell.

entries.title: Spell Spirits (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar on the spirits summoned by Invoke spells: limited intelligence, how others can resist or command them (must exceed the level of the Invoke spell), and that a magus designs the spell first and the spirit follows.

entries.title: Hermetic Theurgy (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue for inventing Invoke spells, each of which forms a pact with one specific named spirit; the base level is the spirit's Might and Range, Duration and Target govern only the invocation. Invoke spells cannot be put into devices.
quotes: the base level is usually all that is needed to summon the spirit

entries.title: Inventing Theurgic Spells in the Laboratory
entries.summary: Gives the modified Lab Total used to research theurgic spells, and how Names of Power can be added to it and to the Casting Score.
quotes: Technique + Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura + (Realm) Lore + Bonuses

entries.title: Invoke the Spirit of (spell)
entries.summary: Mystery spell pact with a named spirit that casts one Formulaic-style spell as a power, with no die roll and no botch. Covers base level from the spirit's Might, Penetration like a device, the first-summons Magic Resistance check, and the spirit's Casting Score and success threshold.
quotes: Spirit Might must equal or exceed level of spell-like power
Penetration Bonus = 2 x added levels of
Spirit's Casting Score = Spirit's Might + Aura Modifier
Spellcasting Succeeds if Casting Total is at least (adjusted spell level –10)

entries.title: Invoke the Spirit of (Form)
entries.summary: Mystery spell pact with a named spirit that produces Spontaneous-style effects of one Technique and Form combination as a power; the spirit's Casting Total is half its Casting Score, with no die roll.
quotes: Casting Total = Casting Score/2 (round up) (no die roll)
Penetration Total = Spirit's Casting Total – Spell Level

entries.title: Invoke the Pact of (Daimon)
entries.requires: Virtue: Hermetic Theurgy (limited use without it)
entries.summary: Mystery Ritual that repeatedly calls a named Daimon until it sends an Aspect to answer. Each casting that beats its Magic Resistance accumulates Summoning Points, and it can be cast in limited form without Hermetic Theurgy.
quotes: Daimon Summoning Points = Spell Level – Daimon's Might
Summoning Success: Accumulated Summoning Points = Daimon's Might

entries.title: Nature Lore
entries.summary: A nature Arcane Ability tied to a type of nature that works as Area Lore at home, is reduced outside its region, lets the maga commune with nature, and is the basis for walking the path to gain further Virtues.
quotes: To represent this, always treat her score in Nature Lore as three less outside of her home region.
A Minor Flaw yields a Minor Virtue, and a Major Flaw grants a Major Virtue.

related.text: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal

entries.title: Sample Nature Lores
entries.summary: Table of example nature types (animal, water, weather, forest, desert, mountain) a maga can specialise in.

entries.title: Using Nature Lore
entries.summary: Scale describing what a maga can do at each Nature Lore score, from basic area knowledge up to commanding all the area's denizens.
quotes: Always treat a maga's score in Nature Lore as three less outside of her home region.

entries.title: Awakening
entries.summary: Lab procedure to awaken a natural spirit or animal using Nature Lore, with a total, effect level, vis cost, and optional powers invested using Might Points.
quotes: Awakening Total: Intelligence + Nature Lore + Technique + Form + Aura
Awakening Level: 25 + Might + (Size x 5), or (Aura + Size modifier) x 5
Awakening Cost: 1 pawn of vis per five levels or fraction
Power Cost: 1 Might Point per ten levels or fraction of the effect, minus 1 for every 5 pawns of (Technique or Form) vis

entries.title: Area Size Modifiers
entries.summary: Table of Size modifiers by area diameter used for Awakening and Guardian of Nature.
quotes: 100 paces in diameter

entries.title: Wilding
entries.summary: A season of work draws temporary vis from a wholly natural vessel matching the maga's Nature Lore; the vis must be used within days and only Wilding Initiates can use it.
quotes: Wilding: (Nature Lore x 2) pawns of (appropriate Form) vis

entries.title: Guardian of Nature
entries.requires: Initiation: Guardian of Nature (Major Nature Mystery)
entries.summary: A maga becomes a guardian spirit of an area (her locus) via a ritual with its own total, vis cost and level; the entry also covers her ghostly state, lack of aging, spellcasting limits and wounds to the locus.
quotes: Guardian Ritual Total: stress die + Presence + Nature Lore
Guardian Ritual Vis Cost: (level of the aura) pawns of (appropriate Form) vis
Guardian Ritual Level: level of the aura x Size modifier

entries.title: Hermetic Architecture (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue for enchanting very large things, such as rooms, buildings, groves and stone circles, by enchanting a set of smaller devices placed in a pattern. The amount of enchantment is the Material times the Size multiplier.
quotes: Multiply Material cost times the Size multiplier of the structure to be enchanted

entries.title: Compound Component Devices
entries.summary: The magus finds a matching component device, makes as many identical copies as the structure's Size multiplier, and places them in a calculated pattern, which needs a Geometry roll; failure takes time to recompute and a botch brings disaster.
quotes: Intelligence + Artes Liberales (Geometry) vs. an Ease Factor of 6 + Size Multiplier

entries.title: Investing the Effects
entries.summary: How lab enchanting works for the component devices of a structure: Material and Shape Bonuses from both components and the intended structure, a choice of structure or device targets, and permission to invest Boundary-target effects.

entries.title: Completing and Binding the Enchantment
entries.summary: After the devices are placed, the magus casts a Mystery rite, formulated as a spell for calculation and vis cost, to link the finished components.

entries.title: Bind the Mystical Structure (Mystery Ritual)
entries.summary: The Mystery Ritual that links the placed component devices into one enchanted structure. Its base level exceeds the highest component effect level by a fixed amount and it needs Arcane Range, with extra levels for larger sizes.
quotes: The base level of the ritual must equal or exceed 5 + level of the highest component device effect levels.
(Create a conduit for spells up to (level + 5 magnitudes), +4 Arcane, +2 Group)

entries.title: Breaking the Device
entries.summary: Component devices may be removed from their niches without destroying the binding, but the effect stops while any is missing; a Muto requisite on the binding fuses devices and holders so they cannot be separated without breakage.

entries.title: Hermetic Empowerment (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue, built on Spell Binding, that lets a magus enchant Ritual effects into a device and power them by draining a bound spirit instead of paying vis. The text lists which Ritual effects can and cannot be empowered this way.
quotes: Invoking a spirit-powered vis-using effect takes no more time or effort on the part of the person triggering the device than any other device invested effect.

entries.title: Hermetic Empowerment: Enchanting the Device
entries.summary: How to instill a Ritual effect into a device with Hermetic Empowerment: the process matches normal enchanting, the effect keeps Ritual minimum level, and it stays inert until a spirit powers it.
quotes: Just like a Ritual spell, the minimum level of a Ritual effect is 20

entries.title: Hermetic Empowerment: Powering Ritual Effects
entries.summary: A bound spirit powers an empowered Ritual effect by permanently losing Might Score, and it can only power effects up to a limit set by its Might. Also covers what happens when the device is broken and the spirit is released.
quotes: Might Score drained = (Ritual level/5) (round up)
Might Score x 2 must equal or exceed Ritual level

entries.title: Empowering Prison of the Declining Spirit (sidebar)
entries.summary: The special Mystery general enchantment that traps a spirit in a device and lets its Might Score fuel Ritual effects; sets how its level relates to the spirit's Might, its Form requisites and per-day uses.
quotes: The base level of the enchantment must equal or exceed twice the Might of the spirit that will be bound to it.
the current Might Score of the bound spirit must equal or exceed half the level of the Ritual effect to be powered

entries.title: Virtue: Hermetic Empowerment (spirit-powered Ritual effects)
entries.summary: Lets a magus enchant Ritual effects into a device powered by a bound spirit, whose permanent Might is drained with each use and which limits the effect level.
quotes: The Effect Level cannot exceed twice the spirit's Might Score, so the spirit cannot be completely drained.

entries.title: Empowering Prison of the Declining Spirit
entries.summary: The Mystery enchantment guideline that binds a spirit in a device to power Ritual effects, with requisites of the Forms involved and a base level tied to the spirit's Might.
quotes: The base level of the enchantment must equal or exceed twice the Might of the spirit that will be bound

entries.title: Franciscan Initiation Scripts
entries.summary: Introduces the available Franciscan Initiation Scripts, which retrace formative experiences in Francis' life, and notes that two of them need a season at Francis' cave near Assisi. The Mystagogue must know the Virtue being granted.
quotes: All require that the Mystagogue knows the Virtue to be gained.

entries.title: Franciscan Initiation: Meditation
entries.summary: Initiation script for the Meditation Virtue: a season of solitary prayer in Francis' cave, with a Quest and Major Ordeal, granting the Meditation Virtue and the Driven Flaw. Gives the Initiation Total, Script Bonus and Sympathy bonus.
quotes: Initiation Total 21, Script Bonus 15: Major Ordeal (9) + Quest (3) + Sympathy bonus: Path of the Founder (3).

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.59 (Psychodrama)

entries.title: Franciscan Initiation: Understanding
entries.summary: Initiation script for the Understanding Virtue: a Quest for an old Byzantine crucifix followed by a vigil and vision at the chapel of Saint Damien, granting the Understanding Virtue and the Visions Flaw. An unworthy Initiate gains Plagued by Supernatural Entity instead.
quotes: Initiation Total 12 (21 - 9 for previous Major Ordeal), Script Bonus 7: Minor Ordeal (3) + Quest (3) + Sympathy bonus: Path of the Founder (1).

entries.title: Franciscan Initiation: Intervention
entries.summary: Initiation script for the Intervention Virtue: a winter season of study with the Mystagogue, a barefoot journey in rags to work as a scullion, and a trip to Rome to obtain a papal blessing without asking for it. Gives the Initiation Total and Script Bonus breakdown.
quotes: Initiation Total 15 (21 - 6 for previous Major Ordeal; Script Bonus 9: Time and place (1) + Initiate's time (1) + Mystagogue's time (3) + Quest (3) + Sympathy bonus: Path of the Founder (1).

entries.title: Franciscan Initiation: Purity
entries.summary: Initiation script for the Purity Virtue: a season of fasting in rags in Francis' cave, counted as an Ordeal that permanently harms the Initiate's constitution, with troupe-played temptations forming a Quest. Grants the Purity Virtue and the Fragile Constitution Flaw.
quotes: Initiation Total 18 (21 - 3 for previous Major Ordeal), Script Bonus 9: Quest (3) + Minor Ordeal (3) + Sympathy bonus: Path of the Founder (3).

entries.title: Franciscan Script Variations
entries.summary: Explains that Francis, guided by angelic advice, tailors the Initiation Scripts to each candidate, and that other Mystagogues may unknowingly use unsuitable Scripts. This deliberately bends the standard Mystery rules to vary Initiates' Flaws.
quotes: This bends the rules set out in The Mysteries: Revised Edition

entries.title: UnGifted Mathematicus Initiations
entries.summary: Explains that an unGifted mathematicus takes both the Flaw and Virtue for each Initiation, that the examples given are only examples, and that Ordeal Flaws relate to the ability to practice magic.
quotes: A player who wishes to play a companion mathematicus must take both the Flaw and Virtue for each Initiation listed.

entries.title: Initiation into the Tueor Technique
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Tueor Technique: a season of service with a Philosophiae test, then a season of teaching, with the Flaws gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +20 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +3 Minor Ordeal, +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Fortunam Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Fortunam Form: a season of service with a Theology test, then a season of teaching, with the Flaws gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +14 (+3 Quest, +6 Minor Ordeals (2), +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Magicam Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Magicam Form: a season of service with a Magic Lore test, then a season of teaching, with the Flaws gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +14 (+3 Quest, +6 Minor Ordeals (2), +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Salutem Form
entries.summary: Initiation Script for the Salutem Form: a season of service with a Medicine test, then a season of teaching, with the Flaws gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +14 (+3 Quest, +6 Minor Ordeals (2), +3 Mystagogue's Time, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Initiation into the Entreat the Divine Powers Ability
entries.requires: Initiation: Entreat the Divine Powers (unGifted mathematicus)
entries.summary: Initiation Script granting the Entreat the Divine Powers Minor Virtue after a season of service with a Divine Lore test, with the Flaw gained.
quotes: Script Bonus: +14 (+3 Quest, +9 Major Ordeal, +1 Initiate's Time, +1 Sympathetic Bonus)

entries.title: Name of Power Spell (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar describing the Name of Power (X) general-level Muto Vim spell, which gives a bonus with a scope agreed with the troupe, built on the Shape and Material Bonus idea.
quotes: The level of spell is five times the desired bonus. Range, Duration, and Target are fixed.

entries.title: Names of Power (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue where a Name of Power is learned as a Muto Vim spell giving a bonus equal to its spell magnitude, usable only with other Mystery Virtues. Names must be spoken aloud, so quiet or silent casting cannot be combined.
quotes: All uses of Names of Power require that the maga speak the names out loud in a firm (or loud) voice

entries.title: Hermetic Theurgy and Names of Power
entries.requires: Virtue: Names of Power and Hermetic Theurgy
entries.summary: How to work a Name of Power into an Invoke spell: its bonus is added to the Lab Total for inventing the spell and to the Casting Score, capped by Magic Theory, and the names must be spoken aloud.
quotes: The total value of all Names of Power combined in a spell cannot exceed her Magic Theory when she invents the spell.
Theurgic Name Bonus = Total Name of Power Bonuses, Limited by Magic Theory

entries.title: Invocation Magic and Names of Power
entries.requires: Virtue: Invocation Magic and Names of Power
entries.summary: How a magus with Invocation Magic casts Names of Power as meta-magic spells in sequence to raise the Casting Score of a following spell; the bonus is limited by Magic Theory and can combine with theurgic and talisman bonuses.
quotes: Invocation Magic Bonus = Total of Name of Power Spell Bonuses, Limited by Magic Theory

entries.title: Consummate Talisman and Names of Power
entries.requires: Virtue: Consummate Talisman and Names of Power
entries.summary: A talisman with the Consummate Talisman Virtue can hold Name of Power effects that add to the magus's Casting Score when he speaks the triggering names aloud, limited by Magic Theory.
quotes: Talisman Name of Power Bonus = Total of Name of Power Effect Bonuses, Limited by Magic Theory

related.text: Chapter 10: The Great Talisman, Consummate Talisman

entries.title: Invocation Magic (Major Mystery Virtue)
entries.requires: Virtue: Invocation Magic (prerequisite: Names of Power)
entries.summary: A Major Mystery Virtue that lets a magus cast Names of Power as Muto Vim spells on himself to add to his Casting Score for the next spell. Covers casting time for each name, the voice requirement, and the special botch consequences.
quotes: Invocation Magic Bonus = Total of Name of Power Spell Bonuses, Limited by Magic Theory
It takes the normal spellcasting time to invoke each Name of Power preceding the main spell

entries.title: Hermetic Numerology (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue based on Artes Liberales (arithmetic) letting a magus devise small Rote formulae and enchant a Numerologist's Book for a bonus to Numerology, Geometry and Architecture; it is also a prerequisite for Divination (Numerology).

entries.title: The Numerologist's Book
entries.summary: How a Numerologist enchants a text as a lesser or greater book that gives a book bonus (capped by Artes Liberales arithmetic) to Divination, lab work and Rote casting, and how it is consulted.
quotes: Lesser Numerologist's Book Opened with 8 Pawns of vis
Lesser Book Bonus is +4
Greater Numerologist's Book Opened with 16 Pawns of vis
Greater Book Bonus is +8

entries.title: Magical Books (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar on how much vis a medieval book costs to open for enchantment (parchment, covers or both) and the new Book Shape Bonus granted.
quotes: +2 Intellego, +3 Divination, +4 Numerology

entries.title: Rotes
entries.summary: Rotes are small memorized spell-like formulae invoked with no die roll, as if with Quiet and Still Casting. Gives the Rote Lab Total, maximum level, Casting Score and Total, Penetration, and the cheaper invention cost.
quotes: Rote Lab Total = Technique + Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Arithmetic + Book Bonus + Aura Modifier
Maximum Rote Level = (Rote Lab Total) / 5
Rote Casting Score = Stamina + Technique + Form + Arithmetic + Book Bonus + Aura Modifier
Rote Casting Total = Casting Score / 2, rounded up.

entries.title: Creating the Numerologist's Book (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar on attuning a text as a Numerologist's Book while opening it: it adds only a short distraction, only its creator gets the bonus, and the lesser and greater versions cost different vis and Magic Theory.
quotes: The lesser Numerologist's Book is created by opening the parchment pages

entries.title: Hubris
entries.summary: The Hubris Personality Trait gained with a Verditius Inner Mystery, which grows with experience points from selling items, winning contests and vendettas, adds to certain enchanting Lab Totals, and must be resisted with opposed rolls.
quotes: A Verditius magus can add his Hubris score to his Lab Totals for creating a talisman, enchanting casting tools
you must make an opposed Personality Trait + stress die roll against an Ease Factor of your maga's Hubris score + her challenger's Hubris score

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.116

entries.title: Enchant Casting Tools
entries.requires: Initiation: Enchant Casting Tools (Verditius Minor House Mystery)
entries.summary: A laboratory process to enchant casting tools to mirror mastered spell abilities and add casting bonuses, using a special Lab Total that must be double the effect level and costing Technique or Form vis.
quotes: ENCHANT CASTING TOOLS LAB TOTAL: Technique + Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura Modifier + Philosophiae + Hubris + Magnitude of Known Spell + Craft (if applicable)
The magus must spend one pawn of Technique or Form specific vis per 10 levels of the final effect level total, rounded up.

entries.title: Initiation of Enchant Casting Tools
entries.summary: The Ease Factor, script bonus and ordeal for initiating Enchant Casting Tools.
quotes: Ease Factor: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)
Script Bonus: +9

entries.title: Verditius Confraternities
entries.summary: Small sub-cults within the House that follow a set Mystery Path with a unique Inner Mystery; four examples (Roland, Balento, Irene the Younger, Himinis the Mad) give the path and a sample Initiation Script with Ease Factor and Script bonus.
quotes: these subsets of magi only contain four to eight followers at any given time

entries.title: Verditius Inner Mysteries Overview
entries.summary: Introduces the four Minor and four Major Inner Mysteries, which may be learned in any order, and explains that each comes with a sample Initiation Script at a standard Target Level that can be lowered by an earlier Ordeal.
quotes: There are four Minor and four Major Inner Mysteries of House Verditius.

entries.title: The Children of Odin Mystery Cult
entries.requires: Initiation: Children of Odin Mystery Cult
entries.summary: Describes the small, secretive Children of Odin cult led by Queen Skuld, its power-based philosophy, and the typical membership, including the suggestion that members need a good Ignem score.
quotes: all members should have a relatively good Ignem Art score, which may favor Flambeau, so that they could survive the first Quest to the burning ships (see below)

entries.title: Children of Odin Mystery Scripts and Ordeals
entries.requires: Initiation: Children of Odin Mystery Cult
entries.summary: Lists the Hermetic Virtues granted by the cult's Initiation Scripts and the Flaws that may be taken as Ordeals, including the new Minor Hermetic Flaw Blood Haze.
quotes: The cult currently has Initiation Scripts that grant the following Virtues:
The maga is crazed by bloodshed, and if she is directly involved in a combat situation she has a –10 penalty to Formulaic magic and has a –3 penalty to her Concentration Ability Score.

related.text: ArM5 p.44 Life Boost, Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic

entries.title: The Ships of Flame (Odin Cult Quest Regiones)
entries.requires: Initiation: Children of Odin Mystery Cult
entries.summary: Three small Magical regiones on the Seine, each a burning longship that can only be entered on a particular day by drifting in a burning boat, and which serve as the cult's first Quest with a fire hazard on deck.
quotes: Each Viking longship burns fiercely and inflicts fire damage (+20 each round) on anyone standing upon the deck. This is a magical attack with a Penetration of 30, which may be resisted as normal.
Cult Initiates must (as their first Quest) find their way, unaided, onto the deck of one of the longships and recover an axe from a fallen Viking warrior

entries.title: Rune Magic for the Order of Odin
entries.requires: Storyguide option; Children of Odin Mystery Cult
entries.summary: Optional rule suggestion: if the cult is an authentic heir to the Order of Odin, add rune magic powers to its repertoire, or let a researcher integrate rune magic with Hermetic theory.
quotes: you might like to add to the cult's repertoire some of the rune magic powers described in Ancient Magic (page 133)

entries.title: Enigmatic Wisdom
entries.requires: House Criamon: Initiation into the Enigma
entries.summary: The Enigmatic Wisdom Ability adds to rolls to interpret dreams, riddles, phantasms and mysterious situations, and affects how often Criamon enter Twilight and how well they survive it.
quotes: Your score in this Ability is added to rolls to interpret dreams and riddles, and to understand phantasms and arcane or mysterious situations.

entries.title: The Path of the Body
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
entries.summary: Describes the Criamon Path of the Body, which focuses on the human form and treats the universe, like the body, as decaying.
quotes: The Path of the Body focuses on the human form.

entries.title: The Avenue of Subduing the Meat and the Station of the Perfect Tool
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
entries.summary: The first Station of the Path of the Body grants Minor Potency in an aspect of Corpus and lets the magus use Enigmatic Wisdom in place of Chirurgy and Medicine, at the cost of a Vow and Deleterious Circumstances when ill.
quotes: They may use their Enigmatic Wisdom score in place of Chirurgy and Medicine in rolls.

entries.title: Initiation of The Avenue of Subduing the Meat, Which Reaches the Station of the Perfect Tool
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
entries.summary: The initiation Ease Factor, script bonus and ordeal details for the first Station of the Path of the Body.
quotes: Ease Factor: 21, as Major Virtue
Script Bonus: +15

entries.title: Structure of the Huntress
entries.requires: Esoteric cult: Huntress in the Wood
entries.summary: Overview of the cult's three ranks (kerykes, eumolpids, hierophants) and the Huntress in the Wood Lore Ability needed for Initiation.

entries.title: Kerykes (Huntress in the Wood)
entries.requires: Esoteric cult: Huntress in the Wood
entries.summary: The outer rank of the cult, which gives the Mystery of Nature Lore. Includes its Initiation Script (Huntress Lore 1, a gift of lore, and an Oath).
quotes: Script Bonus: +9

entries.title: Eumolpids (Huntress in the Wood)
entries.requires: Esoteric cult: Huntress in the Wood; Huntress Lore 3
entries.summary: The inner rank, which gives Hermetic Theurgy and can lead to Names of Power and Invocation Magic. Includes its Initiation Script with a supernatural mark that alienates the Initiate from the fae.
quotes: Script Bonus: +12

entries.title: Hierophants (Huntress in the Wood)
entries.requires: Esoteric cult: Huntress in the Wood
entries.summary: The leading rank of three, who gain Hermetic Synthemata and guard the Script for Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes. Gives both Initiation Scripts.
quotes: Script Bonus: +24
Ease Factor: 30 (Major Virtue unknown to the Mystagogue)

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition, Chapter 9: Hermetic Theurgy

entries.title: Knights of the Green Stone: Structure and Degrees
entries.requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.summary: Describes the three degrees of the cult, the free Minor Status Virtue of knight role-playing, and the rules of membership.
quotes: The Knights divides its Initiates into three degrees, each of which offers up to three Initiations

entries.title: Green Stone Degree: Page
entries.requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.summary: First degree; Initiations into Free Expression, Performance Magic: Music and Puissant Art of Memory.
quotes: The third Virtue taught is Puissant Art of Memory

entries.title: Green Stone Degree: Squire
entries.requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.summary: Second degree; may confer Vulgar Alchemy, Hermetic Numerology and Consummate Talisman.
quotes: The Virtues Vulgar Alchemy, Hermetic Numerology, and Consummate Talisman can be conferred at this degree.

entries.title: Green Stone Degree: Knight
entries.requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.summary: Third degree; Virtues taught are Planetary Magic, a gemstone focus or Potent Magic, and Hermetic Synthemata.
quotes: They learn the Virtues Planetary Magic, Major Magical Focus: Gemstones or Potent Magic: Gemstones, and Hermetic Synthemata

entries.title: The Wolf Brothers (Luperci cult overview)
entries.summary: Introduces the Luperci as a non-Hermetic Mystery Cult whose members use the Wolf's Court for Initiations, with the She-Wolf as magical patron; the storyguide chooses how widespread it is.
quotes: This priesthood still exists as a Mystery Cult

entries.title: The Luperci Mystery Cult: grades and Initiations
entries.summary: Describes the three grades of the Luperci cult, the Organization Lore: Luperci needed for each, the Virtues and Flaws gained at each Initiation and their Initiation Script bonuses and Ease Factors, and the lykaia rite for magistri.
quotes: The most junior grade is called the lupellis, which requires an Organization Lore: Luperci of at least 1.
(Initiation Script +9 for the Major Flaw; Ease Factor 15)
a character must have an Organization Lore: Luperci of 5 before being considered for this rank

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Chapter Two
Realms of Power: Magic p.45 Lesser Power

entries.title: The Luperci as a Hermetic Mystery Cult (variant)
entries.requires: Optional variant: Hermetic version of the Luperci
entries.summary: Optional variant making the Luperci a Hermetic cult open only to magi, adjusting the crimes it avenges and the meaning of its Dark Secret, and noting that Gifted characters need not take an Ordeal at every Initiation.
quotes: Unlike unGifted characters, Gifted individuals do not have to take an Ordeal at every Initiation

entries.title: The Lupercalia curse-breaking rite
entries.summary: Yearly festival during which the senior Luperci present may attempt to dispel a curse on the community with a Communication roll against the curse's level, with bonuses for individuals brought to justice.
quotes: To evoke this power requires a Communication + Organization Lore: Luperci + stress die against an Ease Factor equal to the level of the spell that generated the curse (or 5 x the Supernatural Ability used to lay it).
it receives a bonus of +3 for every individual who has been brought to justice in the last year

entries.title: The Children of Olympos (league and its Mysteries)
entries.summary: Describes the Hermetic league that channels Greek gods and the two Mysteries its leader invented for it, explaining how a channeled god can eventually overcome the recipient.
quotes: Lucian has invented two Mysteries for his followers: Elysian Ecstasy and Olympian Pact.

entries.title: Channeling a Greek god (Elysian Ecstasy and Olympian Pact)
entries.requires: Initiation: Elysian Ecstasy (Minor) or Olympian Pact (Major)
entries.summary: Rules for the roll to channel a Greek god, with a table of Ease Factors giving Personality Trait bonuses, Sympathy Trait points and (for Olympian Pact) access to the god's powers, plus the preparation hours, failure cost and duration.
quotes: Channeling a Greek God: (Characteristic) + Faerie Lore + stress die + aura
A character may spend additional hours in this frenetic state, with each additional hour adding +1 to his die roll.
A character gains Sympathy Traits, Personality Traits, and powers (for Olympian Pact) for a number of hours equal to the total rolled.

related.text: Realms of Power: Faerie, pages 102-105 (Sympathy Traits)
Realms of Power: Magic, page 88 (Spiritual Pact)

entries.title: Initiation of Elysian Ecstasy
entries.summary: The Initiation Script for Elysian Ecstasy, with its Ease Factor, Script Bonus and the twelve boons from beings representing the Olympians.
quotes: The initiate must visit 12 powerful beings, each one chosen to represent one of the 12 Olympians, and receive a boon from each.

entries.title: Great Talisman (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue that lets a magus open a talisman attunement merely by using it in regular magical life, and add new components when reopening it, still one attunement per season.
quotes: He can still only open one attunement per season, even if he reopens or invests an effect in his talisman.

entries.title: Consummate Talisman (Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.requires: Initiation: Consummate Talisman (prerequisite: Great Talisman or Inscription on the Soul)
entries.summary: A Major Mystery Virtue letting a talisman hold Personal-range Muto Vim effects that affect the magus's own spellcasting, including Name of Power effects, at the cost of a Flaw that counts as an Ordeal.
quotes: The magus may enchant Muto Vim effects, with Personal Range, into his talisman, and may use them on himself when he casts Formulaic spells.

entries.title: Inscription on the Soul and Talisman Virtues (sidebar)
entries.requires: Virtue: Inscription on the Soul; Great Talisman or Consummate Talisman
entries.summary: Sidebar on combining Inscription on the Soul with the talisman Virtues: body or spirit attunements can be opened with Great Talisman, and Inscription on the Soul can replace Great Talisman as the prerequisite for Consummate Talisman.

entries.title: Suitable Spirits for a Magus' Magic (sidebar)
entries.requires: Virtue: Hermetic Empowerment or Spirit Familiar
entries.summary: Sidebar saying the realm of a spirit must match the magus's own magic before he can take it as a familiar or drain its Might for Ritual power.
quotes: then the realm of the spirit must in some way match the magus's magic

entries.title: Spirits and Realms (sidebar)
entries.requires: Virtue: Hermetic Theurgy or Spirit Familiar
entries.summary: Sidebar on which spirits a magus can work with: Magic Might spirits for all magi, Faerie spirits with Faerie Magic, Infernal spirits through diabolic practices, and Divine spirits with Divine magic.

entries.title: Spell Spirits
entries.summary: Theurgists can summon spirits whose only power duplicates a specific spell or Form; the summoning duration sets how long the spirit attends.
quotes: A spell spirit has a Might at least equal to the level of the spell

entries.title: Hubris
entries.summary: The Hubris Personality Trait gained with the first Inner Mystery: it grows with experience points from selling and winning, is added to certain Lab Totals, and can be resisted with opposed Personality Trait rolls, notably when refusing a vendetta.
quotes: A Verditius magus can add his Hubris score to his Lab Totals for creating a talisman
you must make an opposed Personality Trait + stress die roll against an Ease Factor of your maga's Hubris score + her challenger's Hubris score

entries.title: Increasing Hubris
entries.summary: A table of behaviors (selling items, winning the Contest, learning Inner Mysteries, vendettas) and the experience points each adds to the Hubris score.
quotes: Winning the master category of the Contest. | 6 |
Selling an automaton. | 1/magnitude of Might |

entries.title: Animae Magic
entries.summary: Lets a maga transform objects into, or summon, temporary faeries called animae using new spell guidelines; animae can be targeted by the Form that matches their nature.

entries.title: Arcadian Travel
entries.summary: Lets a maga open trods between the mortal world, regio levels and Arcadia using a charm and an Arcadian Travel Total compared to Ease Factors from a table; she can bring a limited number of companions.
quotes: Arcadian Travel Total: stress die + Perception + (Ability) + Aura
the Ease Factor is 12 for a mundane place, 15 for a regio level, and 18 if the destination is part of Arcadia
a trod can affect a number of other people equal to her Faerie Magic score

entries.title: Becoming
entries.summary: A maga becomes a faerie through three lab rituals (Body, Mind, Spirit), each with its own level formula and Lab Total limit, then may use lesser transformation rituals; Ordeals reduce the required levels.
quotes: Becoming Lab Total Limit: Warping Score X Faerie Magic
Transforming the Body: (Character's Age – 35) + (5 x Decrepitude Score)
Transforming the Mind: Total Score in Abilities
Transforming the Spirit: Total Score in Arts
Faerie Might Score: Becoming Lab Total / 2

entries.title: The Path of Orpheus
entries.summary: Describes a rumored great ritual that follows Orpheus into the Underworld to restore a dead loved one to life, modelled on the rituals of Fenicil. Gives its parameters, requirements and the limits and risks of its success.
quotes: with an Ease Factor of 78, Range Adelphixis, Duration Momentary, and Target Individual

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.76 (Fenicil)

entries.title: Disciples of the Worm: Structure and Seven Degrees
entries.summary: Explains the cell organization of the cult and lists its seven degrees with the Virtue taught at each, from Second Sight to Living Ghost.
quotes: Initiates are divided into seven degrees

entries.title: The Cult of Eleusis (Eleusinian Mysteries)
entries.requires: Initiation: Eleusinian Mysteries (sponsor required; Greek, no blood guilt)
entries.summary: Describes how a character is sponsored into and initiated in the Eleusinian Mystery cult at Eleusis, with a Lesser Mystery held yearly and a Greater Mystery held less often, and what Virtues each may grant.
quotes: Initiation into the Lesser Mystery occurs once a year in March, and grants the Virtue Self-Confident
The Greater Mystery is initiated once every five years, at the end of August. It may grant the Death Prophecy Virtue

entries.title: Magi in Final Twilight
entries.summary: A magus entering Final Twilight may rarely become a Magical being, with Might set by guideline ranges or formulas tied to an Art or Ability.
quotes: The Might Score of a magus Transformed by Twilight should generally be around 20 to 40.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.24 Great Beasts

entries.title: Hermetic Sacrifice (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue where an unblemished sacrificial animal on a pagan altar substitutes for some of the vis for a Ritual that summons a deity; magic that forces the spirit spoils the altar.
quotes: A pure and satisfactory sacrifice substitutes for between one and six pawns of vis, depending on the nature of the animal.

entries.title: Studying with a Lamia (Palace of the Lamia)
entries.requires: Being taken in by a lamia (Gulf of Corinth)
entries.summary: A magus may be taken to a lamia's underwater palace and taught secrets; a dangerous route to learning, and many lamiae can initiate Mystery Virtues.
quotes: Many lamiae are capable of initiating Mystery Virtues, for example.

entries.title: Losing The Gift
entries.requires: Character who has lost The Gift (for example by Undying One initiation)
entries.summary: Lists the consequences of losing The Gift for a magical character, covering Favored Abilities, inventing spells, Initiation Scripts, Hermetic Virtues and Parma Magica.
quotes: She loses all Hermetic Virtues and Flaws (these may only be possessed by Gifted characters).

entries.title: Neo-Mercurian Road Magic: New Ranges and Targets
entries.requires: Virtue: Mercurian Magic; Road Magic taught or Initiated
entries.summary: New Ranges Road and Road Network and Targets Road and Road Network for Formulaic and Ritual spells (not Spontaneous), taught in one season to a maga with Mercurian Magic; each is equated to an existing level for spell design.
quotes: (For purposes of spell level calculation, Road is the same level as Voice.)
a standard Road size is 100 paces long
A standard Road Network is 10,000 paces long

entries.title: Structure of the Order of the Green Cockerel
entries.requires: Mystery Cult: Order of the Green Cockerel
entries.summary: The seven degrees of the Green Cockerel and the Virtue Initiated at each (Planetary Magic, Vulgar Alchemy, Unaging, Hermetic Alchemy, Lesser Elixir, Philosophic Alchemy, Great Elixir), with degree-specific requirements.
quotes: creating at least seven new Shape and Material Bonuses before progressing to the next degree of Initiation

gated.title: Mystery cult: Magoi of the Star

entries.title: Structure of the Magoi of the Star
entries.requires: Mystery Cult: Magoi of the Star
entries.summary: The seven degrees of the Magoi of the Star and the Virtue Initiated at each (Planetary Magic, Potent Magic, Periapt, Celestial Magic, a Magical Focus or further Potent Magic, Divination and Augury: Astrology), with the Lore prerequisite for the first degree.
quotes: The cult is organized into seven separate degrees of Initiation.
To be Initiated requires a knowledge of Artes Liberales at 4 or greater

entries.title: The Column of Theodosius: prophetic visions and Premonitions
entries.requires: Visiting the Forum of Theodosius; Supernatural Ability: Premonitions to understand or study
entries.summary: Anyone gazing at the column for an hour gets a vision, which only a character with Premonitions can interpret with a roll, and those with Premonitions can also study the column as a limited-use Source Quality.
quotes: succeeding with an Intelligence + Premonitions vs. an Ease Factor set by the storyguide (12 is a good start)
The column may also be studied by those with Premonitions, acting as a Source Quality of 6.

entries.title: The Terrae Cult at Hedyosmos (Cult of the Earth)
entries.requires: Initiation: Terrae Cult (threskeia geine), headed by House Guernicus
entries.summary: Describes the Theban chapter of the Terrae Cult, listing the Virtues its Initiation Scripts confer, typical Ordeal Flaws, and a Terram-aligned variant of the Summoning Virtue that is not Infernal.
quotes: The threskeia geine of Hedyosmos has Initiation Scripts for the following Virtues:
it can instead summon any creature with a Magic Might that is aligned to the Form of Terram
When summoning elementals, the character must use the scouring mechanic to create the elemental de novo.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages, pages 36 & 68
Realms of Power: The Infernal, pages 114-115

entries.title: The Drawing of Maat (tongue magic)
entries.summary: A lost technique of painting the goddess of Truth on the tongue that prevents lying and, once its Mystery is found, creates a tiny possessing faerie that corrects mispronunciation so botches are less likely.
quotes: The faerie checks his words for mispronunciations and corrects them

entries.title: Cult of Wyzwanie (Walking the Path mystery)
entries.requires: Initiation: Cult of Wyzwanie (Walking the Path)
entries.summary: A sketch of a mystery cult based on Walking the Path, where a character accepts a Flaw as Sacrifice, completes a Quest for the spirit and gains a Virtue as Fruit, with suggested appropriate Virtues and Quests.
quotes: The character makes a Sacrifice (by accepting a Flaw), finishes a Quest (by serving the spirit in some way), in order to gain the Fruit (a Virtue).

related.text: Guardians of the Forests pp.35-40 Walking the Path
